actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“拉格朗日乘子直觉：关系图”。光靠手拖还不足以看清全貌。现在我们切换到关系图，把原函数、约束和拉格朗日函数之间的逻辑链条一次性梳理出来。

actions.content: 这是原函数 f，我们想要优化的对象。

actions.text: 大家先注意左边这个代表原函数 f 的节点。在课堂上我们反复强调，拉格朗日方法的起点永远是明确你要优化什么——把目光定在这里，避免一上来就被 λ 吓住。

actions.content: 约束条件 g 节点，它画定了允许行动的边界。

actions.text: 接着看右下方的约束 g，它就是我们刚拖动的那条曲线所对应的方程。没有这个约束，优化就只是普通的求导；一加上它，f 和 g 必须同时满足某个条件。

actions.content: 乘子 λ 作为独立变量节点出现，而不是固定数字。

actions.text: 现在中间出现了拉格朗日乘子 λ。请注意它被单独画成一个节点——这意味着 λ 是一个变量，不是事先给定的常数。很多同学在这里误以为 λ 只是某个固定倍数，实际上在构造拉格朗日函数 L(x,λ) 时，我们对 λ 同样会求偏导。

actions.content: L(x,λ) 同时接收 f 和 g 的输入，表示两者的结合。

actions.text: 最后看顶部的 L(x,λ)，它把 f、g 和 λ 的连线汇聚到一起。对 L 分别求偏导，等价于同时满足两个条件：f 和 g 的梯度平行，以及 g=0 落在边界上。这种视觉上的汇聚，就是梯度平衡的代数镜像。接下来你可以用手指指一指每条连线对应的偏导数，看看哪一条你还不理解，我们接着讨论。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>拉格朗日乘子直觉挑战</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #4a90e2;
            --secondary: #f39c12;
            --success: #2ecc71;
            --danger: #e74c3c;
            --bg: #1a1a2e;
            --panel: #16213e;
            --text: #e9ecef;
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
        }

        #game-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 800px;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        canvas {
            flex-grow: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, #1b262c 0%, #0f4c75 100%);
            touch-action: none;
        }

        .ui-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            padding: 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .stats-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            padding: 10px 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .control-panel {
            background: var(--panel);
            padding: 20px;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--primary);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .control-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        label {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--primary);
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        input[type="range"] {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: #0f4c75;
            outline: none;
            -webkit-appearance: none;
        }

        input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background: var(--secondary);
            border-radius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .btn {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        #start-screen, #success-screen {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.95);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 100;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 40px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .hidden { display: none !important; }

        .vector-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

        .legend-item {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }

        h1 { color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 10px; }
        p { line-height: 1.6; max-width: 500px; }

        .achievement-popup {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 300px;
            right: 20px;
            background: var(--success);
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transform: translateX(200%);
            transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .achievement-popup.show { transform: translateX(0); }
    </style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<script>
/**
 * LAGRANGE MULTIPLIER INTUITION GAME
 * Logic: Player adjusts position s on a constraint g(x,y)=0 
 * and multiplier λ to satisfy ∇f + λ∇g = 0.
 */

let canvas, ctx;
let gameActive = false;
let currentLevel = 0;
let score = 0;
let lastTime = 0;

// Game State
let state = {
    pos: 0.2, // position along curve [0,1]
    lambda: 0,
    ballPos: {x: 0, y: 0},
    gradF: {x: 0, y: 0},
    gradG: {x: 0, y: 0},
    netForce: 0,
    isBalanced: false,
    timer: 0
};

const levels = [
    {
        name: "线性约束 (Linear Constraint)",
        f: (x, y) => -0.5 * (Math.pow(x - 400, 2) + Math.pow(y - 200, 2)), 
        gradF: (x, y) => ({x: -(x - 400), y: -(y - 200)}),
        // g: x + y - 600 = 0
        getPoint: (s) => ({ x: 200 + s * 400, y: 500 - s * 400 }),
        gradG: (s) => ({x: 100, y: 100}), // Scaled for visual
        targetPos: 0.5,
        targetLambda: 1.0
    },
    {
        name: "圆形边界 (Circular Boundary)",
        f: (x, y) => -(x - 300) * 0.5, // Wind/Slope force
        gradF: (x, y) => ({x: -50, y: 20}),
        // Circle constraint
        getPoint: (s) => {
            const angle = s * Math.PI * 2;
            return { x: 400 + 150 * Math.cos(angle), y: 300 + 150 * Math.sin(angle) };
        },
        gradG: (s) => {
            const angle = s * Math.PI * 2;
            return { x: 100 * Math.cos(angle), y: 100 * Math.sin(angle) };
        },
        targetPos: 0.43,
        targetLambda: 0.5
    },
    {
        name: "对偶挑战 (Dual Challenge)",
        f: (x, y) => -0.01 * (Math.pow(x-400, 2) + Math.pow(y-300, 2)),
        gradF: (x, y) => ({x: -(x-400)*0.5, y: -(y-300)*0.5}),
        getPoint: (s) => {
            const x = 200 + s * 400;
            const y = 300 + 100 * Math.sin(s * Math.PI * 2);
            return {x, y};
        },
        gradG: (s) => {
            // Derivative of sin curve
            const dy = 100 * 2 * Math.PI * Math.cos(s * Math.PI * 2);
            // Normal vector to (1, dy/dx) is (-dy/dx, 1)
            const nx = -dy/400;
            const ny = 1;
            const mag = Math.sqrt(nx*nx + ny*ny);
            return {x: nx/mag * 100, y: ny/mag * 100};
        },
        targetPos: 0.25,
        targetLambda: -0.8
    }
];

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
    ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    // Bind Controls
    const posSlider = document.getElementById('pos-slider');
    const lambdaSlider = document.getElementById('lambda-slider');
    
    posSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        state.pos = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        document.getElementById('pos-val').innerText = state.pos.toFixed(2);
    });

    lambdaSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        state.lambda = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        document.getElementById('lambda-val').innerText = state.lambda.toFixed(2);
    });
});

function resize() {
    canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
}

window.startGame = function() {
    document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    gameActive = true;
    currentLevel = 0;
    score = 0;
    initLevel();
    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
};

function initLevel() {
    const level = levels[currentLevel];
    document.getElementById('level-idx').innerText = `${currentLevel + 1}/${levels.length}`;
    state.pos = 0.1;
    state.lambda = 0;
    state.timer = 0;
    state.isBalanced = false;
    
    // Reset sliders
    document.getElementById('pos-slider').value = 0.1;
    document.getElementById('lambda-slider').value = 0;
    document.getElementById('pos-val').innerText = "0.10";
    document.getElementById('lambda-val').innerText = "0.00";
    
    document.getElementById('success-screen').classList.add('hidden');
}

function drawGrid() {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const step = 50;
    for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += step) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += step) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y); ctx.stroke();
    }
}

function drawConstraint() {
    const level = levels[currentLevel];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(74, 144, 226, 0.4)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    for (let s = 0; s <= 1.01; s += 0.01) {
        const p = level.getPoint(s);
        if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
}

function drawArrow(x, y, vx, vy, color, label) {
    if (Math.abs(vx) < 1 && Math.abs(vy) < 1) return;
    const headlen = 10;
    const angle = Math.atan2(vy, vx);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + vx, y + vy);
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + vx, y + vy);
    ctx.lineTo(x + vx - headlen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y + vy - headlen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
    ctx.lineTo(x + vx - headlen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y + vy - headlen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fill();

    if (label) {
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.font = "bold 14px Arial";
        ctx.fillText(label, x + vx + 5, y + vy + 5);
    }
}

function gameLoop(time) {
    if (!gameActive) return;
    const dt = (time - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = time;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    drawGrid();
    drawConstraint();

    const level = levels[currentLevel];
    const p = level.getPoint(state.pos);
    const gf = level.gradF(p.x, p.y);
    const gg = level.gradG(state.pos);
    
    // Scale gradG by lambda
    const lgg = { x: gg.x * state.lambda, y: gg.y * state.lambda };
    const net = { x: gf.x + lgg.x, y: gf.y + lgg.y };
    const netMag = Math.sqrt(net.x * net.x + net.y * net.y);

    // Visuals
    drawArrow(p.x, p.y, gf.x, gf.y, '#ff4757', '∇f');
    drawArrow(p.x, p.y, lgg.x, lgg.y, '#2ed573', 'λ∇g');
    drawArrow(p.x, p.y, net.x, net.y, '#eccc68', 'Total Force');

    // Ball
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = netMag < 15 ? '#2ecc71' : '#f1c40f';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
    ctx.shadowColor = ctx.fillStyle;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Balance Logic
    const balanceIndicator = document.getElementById('balance-indicator');
    if (netMag < 12) {
        balanceIndicator.innerText = "正在平衡... Balancing...";
        balanceIndicator.style.color = "var(--success)";
        state.timer += dt;
        if (state.timer > 1.5 && !state.isBalanced) {
            triggerSuccess();
        }
    } else {
        balanceIndicator.innerText = "未平衡 Unbalanced";
        balanceIndicator.style.color = "var(--danger)";
        state.timer = 0;
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function triggerSuccess() {
    state.isBalanced = true;
    score += 10 + Math.max(0, Math.floor(20 - state.timer));
    document.getElementById('score').innerText = score;
    
    const screen = document.getElementById('success-screen');
    const msg = document.getElementById('success-msg');
    screen.classList.remove('hidden');
    
    if (currentLevel === 0) {
        msg.innerHTML = "<b>太棒了！</b> 你发现了线性约束下的平衡点。<br>此时 ∇f + λ∇g = 0，这意味着函数在约束方向上的变化率为零。";
    } else if (currentLevel === 1) {
        msg.innerHTML = "<b>完美对齐！</b> 在圆形边界上，λ 控制了法向力的大小。<br>由于 λ 为正，∇f 与 ∇g 方向相反，实现了极值。";
        showAchievement("切线大师 (Tangent Master)");
    } else {
        msg.innerHTML = "<b>大师级直觉！</b> 你甚至在复杂的非线性曲线上找到了平衡。<br>这就是拉格朗日乘子法的精髓：寻找目标与约束梯度的共线点。";
        document.getElementById('next-btn').innerText = "重新挑战";
        showAchievement("对偶专家 (Dual Expert)");
    }
}

window.nextLevel = function() {
    currentLevel++;
    if (currentLevel >= levels.length) {
        currentLevel = 0;
        score = 0;
        document.getElementById('score').innerText = "0";
    }
    initLevel();
};

function showAchievement(name) {
    const ach = document.getElementById('achievement');
    document.getElementById('ach-name').innerText = name;
    ach.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => ach.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
}

</script>
</body>
</html>

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“拉格朗日乘子直觉：误解修复挑战”。λ) 如何把梯度平行和边界条件汇聚在一起。现在，是时候来修复一个最常见的误解了——以为只要在纸面上解方程就能找到极值点。
不。如果你忽略了方向，只做代数代换，你会发现小球根本停不下来。在这个挑战里，你要亲自调节 λ 的大小和正负，让绿色的 λ∇g 向量刚好抵消红色的 ∇f 向量。

actions.content: 初始状态下，∇f 和 ∇g 方向不同，λ 为 0，系统处于失衡状态。
拖动这个滑块改变 λ 的值和符号，让绿色箭头反向伸长或缩短。

actions.text: 现在试着拖动滑块。注意，只有当 λ∇g 与 ∇f 大小相等且方向相反时，合力才会归零，小球才会停在切点上。这就是几何上的“力平衡”。

actions.content: 提示：合力归零时，切点处的约束曲线与等高线刚好相切。

actions.text: 一旦你成功让小球停驻，你就真正感受到了拉格朗日乘子在空间中的物理直觉——不是代数消元，而是方向对齐。试试看，看谁最快通关。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>拉格朗日乘子直觉：空间视角</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 16px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
    #loading .spinner {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 35, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 300px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #ddd;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    #info h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    #info .subtitle {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #888;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    #info .formula {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      margin: 8px 0;
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #e0e0e0;
    }
    #info .highlight {
      color: #f87171;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 28, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 12px 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 80px;
    }

    label {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: #888;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: #333;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .toggle-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .toggle-row label {
      text-transform: none;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #ccc;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .toggle-row input[type="checkbox"] {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      accent-color: #6366f1;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button {
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #2a2a3a;
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 44px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    button:hover { background: #3a3a4a; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; }
    button.primary:hover { background: #5558e8; }
    button.accent { background: #f59e0b; color: #111; }
    button.accent:hover { background: #d97706; }

    .zoom-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .zoom-btns button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: bold;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      background: #2a2a3a;
    }

    .legend {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 35, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .legend-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 4px 0;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #ccc;
    }
    .legend-color {
      width: 20px;
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .legend-dot {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      .legend { display: none; }
      #controls { padding: 10px 8px 18px; gap: 8px; }
      button { padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
    }
  </style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

  <script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"data:text/javascript;base64,","three/addons/":"https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/","three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js":"data:text/javascript;base64,"}}</script>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    function checkWebGL() {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
          (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')));
      } catch(e) { return false; }
    }

    async function initScene() {
      try {
        if (!checkWebGL()) throw new Error('WebGL 不受支持');

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('容器尺寸为零');

        // Scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0a0a1a, 20, 50);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width / height, 0.1, 200);
        camera.position.set(4, 5, 6);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
        controls.target.set(0.5, 0.3, 0.5);
        controls.minDistance = 2;
        controls.maxDistance = 30;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x8888ff, 0x444444, 0.6);
        scene.add(hemiLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight.position.set(8, 12, 8);
        dirLight.castShadow = true;
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const dirLight2 = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffeedd, 0.4);
        dirLight2.position.set(-5, 8, -5);
        scene.add(dirLight2);

        // Objects storage
        const objects = {
          surfaceF: null,
          constraintPlane: null,
          intersectionCurve: null,
          tangencyPoint: null,
          gradientF: null,
          gradientG: null,
          levelCurves: null,
          gradientFieldF: null,
          gradientFieldG: null,
          groundPlane: null,
          gridHelper: null
        };

        let animationSpeed = 1;
        let isPlaying = true;
        let time = 0;

        // ============ Helper: create arrow ============
        function createArrow(origin, direction, length, color) {
          const group = new THREE.Group();

          const dir = direction.clone().normalize();
          const arrowLen = length * 0.75;
          const shaftLen = arrowLen * 0.8;
          const headLen = arrowLen * 0.2;

          // Shaft
          const shaftGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.025, 0.025, shaftLen, 8);
          const shaftMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.3 });
          const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(shaftGeo, shaftMat);
          shaft.position.set(0, shaftLen / 2, 0);

          // Head
          const headGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, headLen, 8);
          const headMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.5 });
          const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeo, headMat);
          head.position.set(0, shaftLen + headLen / 2, 0);

          // Orient
          const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
          const quaternion = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(up, dir);
          shaft.quaternion.copy(quaternion);
          head.quaternion.copy(quaternion);

          group.add(shaft);
          group.add(head);
          group.position.copy(origin);

          return group;
        }

        // ============ f(x,y) = x² + y² surface (paraboloid) ============
        function createParaboloid() {
          const size = 3;
          const segments = 48;
          const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size * 2, size * 2, segments, segments);
          const pos = geo.attributes.position;

          for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
            const x = pos.getX(i);
            const y = pos.getY(i);
            pos.setZ(i, x * x + y * y);
          }
          geo.computeVertexNormals();

          // Create a gradient-like color for the surface
          const colors = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
            const z = pos.getZ(i);
            const t = Math.min(z / 6, 1);
            // Blue to cyan gradient
            const r = 0.2 + t * 0.3;
            const g = 0.4 + t * 0.3;
            const b = 0.8 - t * 0.2;
            colors.push(r, g, b);
          }
          geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));

          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            vertexColors: true,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.85,
            shininess: 30,
            specular: 0x222244
          });

          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
          mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
          mesh.castShadow = true;
          mesh.receiveShadow = true;
          return mesh;
        }

        // ============ Constraint plane g(x,y) = x + y - 1 = 0 ============
        function createConstraintPlane() {
          const size = 4;
          const segments = 32;
          const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size * 2, size * 2, segments, 1);
          const pos = geo.attributes.position;

          // This plane is vertical, normal (1,1,0)/√2
          // We'll build it manually
          const vertices = [];
          const indices = [];
          const segsX = segments;
          const segsZ = 2;

          for (let iz = 0; iz <= segsZ; iz++) {
            for (let ix = 0; ix <= segsX; ix++) {
              const x = (ix / segsX - 0.5) * size * 2;
              const z = (iz / segsZ - 0.5) * size * 1.5;
              const y = 1 - x; // x + y = 1
              vertices.push(x, z, y);
            }
          }

          for (let iz = 0; iz < segsZ; iz++) {
            for (let ix = 0; ix < segsX; ix++) {
              const a = iz * (segsX + 1) + ix;
              const b = a + 1;
              const c = a + segsX + 1;
              const d = c + 1;
              indices.push(a, b, c, b, d, c);
            }
          }

          const planeGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          planeGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
          planeGeo.setIndex(indices);
          planeGeo.computeVertexNormals();

          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xf89e3a,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.35,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            shininess: 10
          });

          return new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, mat);
        }

        // ============ Intersection curve (f surface ∩ constraint plane) ============
        function createIntersectionCurve() {
          const points = [];
          const steps = 80;
          for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
            const t = (i / steps - 0.5) * 4;
            const x = t;
            const y = 1 - t;
            const z = x * x + y * y;
            points.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, z, y));
          }
          const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
          const tubeGeo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 100, 0.03, 8, false);
          const tubeMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xff4444,
            emissive: 0xff2222,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.4,
            shininess: 60
          });
          return new THREE.Mesh(tubeGeo, tubeMat);
        }

        // ============ Tangency point P(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) ============
        function createTangencyPoint() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();

          // Glowing sphere
          const sphereGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 24, 24);
          const sphereMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xffff00,
            emissive: 0xffff00,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.8,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.9
          });
          const sphere = new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo, sphereMat);
          group.add(sphere);

          // Outer glow ring
          const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.15, 0.25, 32);
          const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: 0xffff00,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.5,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
          });
          const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
          ring.lookAt(camera.position);
          group.add(ring);

          group.position.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
          return group;
        }

        // ============ Gradient vectors at tangency point ============
        function createGradientVectors() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();

          // ∇f = (1, 1, -2) at P — upward pointing normal
          // We show the 3D gradient of f: direction (1, 1, -2) normalized, scaled
          const gradFDir = new THREE.Vector3(1, -2, 1).normalize(); // Upward normal
          const arrowF = createArrow(
            new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
            gradFDir,
            1.2,
            0x44ff88
          );
          arrowF.userData.label = '∇f';
          group.add(arrowF);

          // ∇g = (1, 0, 1) at P — constraint normal (in x,y plane only)
          const gradGDir = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 1).normalize();
          const arrowG = createArrow(
            new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
            gradGDir,
            1.2,
            0xff88ff
          );
          arrowG.userData.label = '∇g';
          group.add(arrowG);

          // Horizontal projection arrows (on the tangent plane)
          // ∇f projected: (1, 1) in xy plane → direction (1, 0, 1) in our coordinate system
          const projF = createArrow(
            new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
            new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 1).normalize(),
            0.8,
            0x88ffcc
          );
          group.add(projF);

          // ∇g horizontal: (1, 1) in xy plane → same direction
          const projG = createArrow(
            new THREE.Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
            new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 1).normalize(),
            0.8,
            0xcc88cc
          );
          group.add(projG);

          return group;
        }

        // ============ Level curves of f on the ground plane ============
        function createLevelCurves() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const levels = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0];
          const colors = [0x2266aa, 0x3377bb, 0x4488cc, 0x5599dd, 0x66aadd, 0x77bbff, 0x88ccff, 0x99ddff];

          levels.forEach((level, idx) => {
            const radius = Math.sqrt(level);
            if (radius > 3) return;

            const curvePoints = [];
            const steps = 64;
            for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
              const angle = (i / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
              curvePoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(
                Math.cos(angle) * radius,
                0.01,
                Math.sin(angle) * radius
              ));
            }
            const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(curvePoints);
            const geo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 80, 0.015, 6, true);
            const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
              color: colors[idx],
              emissive: colors[idx],
              emissiveIntensity: 0.2
            });
            group.add(new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat));
          });

          return group;
        }

        // ============ Gradient field on f surface ============
        function createGradientField() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const step = 1.2;

          for (let x = -2.4; x <= 2.4; x += step) {
            for (let y = -2.4; y <= 2.4; y += step) {
              const dist = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
              if (dist > 2.5) continue;

              const z = x * x + y * y;
              // ∇f = (2x, 2y) in horizontal, full 3D gradient for surface normal
              const gradX = 2 * x;
              const gradY = 2 * y;
              const gradLen = Math.sqrt(gradX * gradX + gradY * gradY);
              if (gradLen < 0.1) continue;

              const scale = Math.min(0.3, gradLen * 0.15);
              const dir = new THREE.Vector3(gradX, 0, gradY).normalize();
              const origin = new THREE.Vector3(x, z + 0.02, y);

              const arrow = createArrow(origin, dir, scale, 0x44ff88);
              arrow.traverse(child => {
                if (child.material) {
                  child.material.transparent = true;
                  child.material.opacity = 0.6;
                }
              });
              group.add(arrow);
            }
          }

          return group;
        }

        // ============ Constraint field ∇g ============
        function createConstraintGradientField() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const step = 1.5;

          for (let x = -2.4; x <= 2.4; x += step) {
            for (let y = -2.4; y <= 2.4; y += step) {
              const z = x * x + y * y;
              // ∇g = (1, 1) constant, but only along constraint
              // Show on the constraint plane
              if (Math.abs(x + y - 1) > 0.8) continue;

              const dir = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 1).normalize();
              const origin = new THREE.Vector3(x, z + 0.05, y);

              const arrow = createArrow(origin, dir, 0.25, 0xff88ff);
              arrow.traverse(child => {
                if (child.material) {
                  child.material.transparent = true;
                  child.material.opacity = 0.5;
                }
              });
              group.add(arrow);
            }
          }

          return group;
        }

        // ============ Ground plane ============
        function createGroundPlane() {
          const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(20, 20);
          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0x111122,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.5,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
          });
          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
          mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
          mesh.position.y = -0.01;
          mesh.receiveShadow = true;
          return mesh;
        }

        // ============ Constraint line on ground (g=0) ============
        function createConstraintLineGround() {
          const points = [
            new THREE.Vector3(-3, 0.02, 4),
            new THREE.Vector3(4, 0.02, -3)
          ];
          const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
          const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
            color: 0xf89e3a,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.7
          });
          return new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
        }

        // ============ Build scene ============
        objects.groundPlane = createGroundPlane();
        scene.add(objects.groundPlane);

        objects.gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(12, 24, 0x222244, 0x1a1a33);
        objects.gridHelper.position.y = 0;
        scene.add(objects.gridHelper);

        objects.surfaceF = createParaboloid();
        scene.add(objects.surfaceF);

        objects.constraintPlane = createConstraintPlane();
        scene.add(objects.constraintPlane);

        objects.intersectionCurve = createIntersectionCurve();
        scene.add(objects.intersectionCurve);

        objects.tangencyPoint = createTangencyPoint();
        scene.add(objects.tangencyPoint);

        objects.gradientF = createGradientVectors();
        scene.add(objects.gradientF);

        objects.levelCurves = createLevelCurves();
        scene.add(objects.levelCurves);

        objects.gradientFieldF = createGradientField();
        scene.add(objects.gradientFieldF);

        objects.constraintGradientField = createConstraintGradientField();
        scene.add(objects.constraintGradientField);

        objects.constraintLineGround = createConstraintLineGround();
        scene.add(objects.constraintLineGround);

        // ============ Axis helpers ============
        const axisLen = 3.5;
        // X axis
        const xAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
          new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
          axisLen, 0xff4444, 0.15, 0.08
        );
        scene.add(xAxis);
        // Y axis (up in 3D)
        const yAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
          axisLen, 0x44ff44, 0.15, 0.08
        );
        scene.add(yAxis);
        // Z axis (our "y" in function notation)
        const zAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1),
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
          axisLen, 0x4444ff, 0.15, 0.08
        );
        scene.add(zAxis);

        // ============ Controls ============
        document.getElementById('speed-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          animationSpeed = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        });

        document.getElementById('show-gradients').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          objects.gradientF.visible = e.target.checked;
        });

        document.getElementById('show-levels').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          objects.levelCurves.visible = e.target.checked;
        });

        document.getElementById('show-field').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          objects.gradientFieldF.visible = e.target.checked;
          objects.constraintGradientField.visible = e.target.checked;
        });

        // Zoom
        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, 2);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, -2);
        });

        // Reset
        document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(4, 5, 6);
          controls.target.set(0.5, 0.3, 0.5);
        });

        // Top view preset
        document.getElementById('preset-top-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(0.5, 10, 0.5);
          controls.target.set(0.5, 0, 0.5);
        });

        // ============ Animation ============
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);

          if (isPlaying) {
            time += 0.016 * animationSpeed;
          }

          // Pulse tangency point
          if (objects.tangencyPoint) {
            const pulse = 1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(time * 3);
            objects.tangencyPoint.scale.setScalar(pulse);
            // Rotate ring
            if (objects.tangencyPoint.children[1]) {
              objects.tangencyPoint.children[1].lookAt(camera.position);
            }
          }

          // Subtle surface wave animation
          if (objects.surfaceF) {
            objects.surfaceF.material.opacity = 0.82 + 0.03 * Math.sin(time * 1.5);
          }

          // Rotate gradient field subtly
          if (objects.gradientFieldF && objects.gradientFieldF.visible) {
            objects.gradientFieldF.rotation.y = Math.sin(time * 0.3) * 0.02;
          }

          controls.update();
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // ============ Resize ============
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const w = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const h = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = w / h;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(w, h);
        });

        // ============ postMessage listener ============
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          const { action, payload } = event.data || {};

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(...payload.cameraPosition);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(...payload.cameraTarget);
              }
              if (payload.animationSpeed !== undefined) {
                animationSpeed = payload.animationSpeed;
                document.getElementById('speed-slider').value = animationSpeed;
              }
              if (payload.playing !== undefined) {
                isPlaying = payload.playing;
              }
              if (payload.showGradients !== undefined) {
                objects.gradientF.visible = payload.showGradients;
                document.getElementById('show-gradients').checked = payload.showGradients;
              }
              if (payload.showLevels !== undefined) {
                objects.levelCurves.visible = payload.showLevels;
                document.getElementById('show-levels').checked = payload.showLevels;
              }
              if (payload.showField !== undefined) {
                objects.gradientFieldF.visible = payload.showField;
                objects.constraintGradientField.visible = payload.showField;
                document.getElementById('show-field').checked = payload.showField;
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'surfaceF' && objects.surfaceF) {
                objects.surfaceF.material.emissive.set(highlight ? 0x444488 : 0x000000);
                objects.surfaceF.material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.5 : 0;
              }
              if (elementId === 'constraintPlane' && objects.constraintPlane) {
                objects.constraintPlane.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.7 : 0.35;
              }
              if (elementId === 'tangencyPoint' && objects.tangencyPoint) {
                objects.tangencyPoint.children[0].material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 1.5 : 0.8;
              }
              if (elementId === 'intersectionCurve' && objects.intersectionCurve) {
                objects.intersectionCurve.material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.8 : 0.4;
              }
              if (elementId === 'gradientF' && objects.gradientF) {
                objects.gradientF.visible = highlight;
              }
              if (elementId === 'levelCurves' && objects.levelCurves) {
                objects.levelCurves.visible = highlight;
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              console.log(`Annotate ${elementId}: ${text}`);
              // Could add HTML label overlays here
              break;
            }

            case 'TOGGLE_GRADIENTS': {
              const show = payload.show !== false;
              objects.gradientF.visible = show;
              document.getElementById('show-gradients').checked = show;
              break;
            }

            case 'TOGGLE_LEVELS': {
              const show = payload.show !== false;
              objects.levelCurves.visible = show;
              document.getElementById('show-levels').checked = show;
              break;
            }

            case 'SET_PRESET': {
              const { preset } = payload;
              if (preset === 'topView') {
                camera.position.set(0.5, 10, 0.5);
                controls.target.set(0.5, 0, 0.5);

objects.name: 目标函数曲面 f(x,y) = x² + y²
约束平面 g(x,y) = x + y − 1 = 0

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“拉格朗日乘子直觉：空间视角”。现在我们把这个直觉升维到 3D 空间里，看一看目标函数曲面 f 和约束平面 g 究竟是怎么“相遇”的。
页面中央这个向上开口的蓝色曲面就是我们的目标函数 f(x,y)=x²+y²，倾斜的橙色平面则是约束 g(x,y)=x+y-1=0。请先花几秒钟旋转视角，试着从不同角度观察它们相交的红色曲线。

actions.content: 放大仔细看切点

actions.text: 现在请打开梯度向量和梯度场的显示，然后切换到俯视图。你会清楚地看到，在黄色的切点上，两个曲面的梯度恰好方向一致——这就是拉格朗日乘子的几何本质：在最优解处，目标函数的梯度与约束函数的梯度平行。

actions.content: 观察两个梯度在切点处对齐

actions.text: 试试看：慢慢放大这个切点，感受一下如果稍微偏离一点点，这两个梯度方向就立刻错开——这正好解释了为什么“只能在这里停下来”。当你准备好之后，我们下一环节会把这些空间直觉映射为关系图中的逻辑链条。

scenes.title: 形成性测验：检查第一组场景并承接下一组知识点

questions.question: 在场景3的实验中，若将约束边界 g(x,y)=c 向右移动（即 c 的值增加），而目标函数 f(x,y) 保持不变，拉格朗日乘子 λ 的值通常会如何变化？（提示：λ 衡量了约束的边际价值）

options.label: λ 一定会增大
λ 一定会减小
λ 的变化取决于约束移动方向是否与目标函数增长方向一致
λ 始终保持不变，因为最优点变了

questions.analysis: 拉格朗日乘子 λ 代表当约束常数 c 增加一个单位时，目标函数最优值的变化率。λ 的正负和大小取决于约束是否限制了目标函数的增长。如果放宽约束（c 增大）使得目标函数能达到更大的值，则 λ 为正值；如果 c 增大反而迫使目标函数减小，则 λ 为负值。其具体数值变化取决于局部敏感性，并不一定是单调的增大或减小，故选项C最为准确。

questions.question: 在场景8中，我们观察到在最优点处，目标函数的梯度向量与约束函数的梯度向量是平行的。这种“梯度平行”状态在数学上精确说明了什么？

options.label: 目标函数和约束函数在该点有相同的函数值
目标函数的等高线与约束曲线在该点相切，无法通过沿约束移动来进一步改善目标值
该点一定是目标函数的全局最大值点
目标函数和约束函数的曲面在该点完全重合

questions.analysis: 梯度平行是拉格朗日乘数法的核心条件。它意味着目标函数梯度是约束函数梯度的倍数。几何上，这意味着目标函数的等高线方向与约束曲线的切线方向垂直，即两者相切。此时，任何沿着约束曲线的微小移动，都会落入目标函数的同一等高线上（导数的一阶近似为0），无法再增加或减少目标值，因此是约束最优的必要条件。

questions.question: （桥接预诊断）给定一个平面上的圆形区域。在圆内任选两个点并将它们用直线段连接。若整个线段都严格位于圆的内部，则该圆形区域可以直观地称为“凸的”。那么，以下哪个图形也满足这个“连线始终在内部”的性质？

options.label: 月牙形（新月形）
实心正方形
五角星形轮廓
圆环（甜甜圈形状）

questions.analysis: 实心正方形是典型的凸集。其内部任意两点的连线，依然完全位于正方形内部。月牙形、五角星轮廓和圆环都存在凹陷或空洞，可以找到两个点，其连线会穿过图形外部，因此它们不是凸集。凸性的核心直观就是集合的饱满性和无凹痕。

questions.question: （桥接预诊断）设想我们正走在两个不同的山谷地形中。第一个山谷像一个光滑的沙拉碗，碗底只有一个最深点，从任意方向往下走都能到达。第二个山谷是一条弯曲的河道，局部看河床是最低点，但沿河道走一段后会进入一个更深的盆地。从山顶的视角看，第一个山谷展现了何种特性？

options.label: 局部凸性，即局部看起来是碗状的
全局凸性，即整个地形是单一的碗状，任何局部最低点就是全局最低点
局部拟凸性，即只有一个谷底但两侧可能不对称
非凸性，因为有弯曲的河道

questions.analysis: 第一个地形描述的是一个“碗状”结构，其最重要的性质是全局凸性。这保证了没有其他隐藏的盆地，任何找到的底部（局部极小值）就是整个地形的最低点（全局极小值）。第二个地形是局部碗状（河道）但全局并非单一碗状（还有更深的盆地），它虽然是拟凸的（局部最小值也是全局最小值对于某些拟凸函数成立，但更典型的非凸函数也可能有多个局部极小值），但核心区别在于全局凸性保证只有一个极小值。题目强调的是从山顶看，整个地形就是一个单一的大碗。

questions.question: 在场景3的实验背景下，将约束 g(x,y)=c 代入目标函数 f(x,y) 的等高线分析中。如果最优点恰好位于某条等高线上，且该点处约束无法再移动以跨入更高（或更低）的等高线，这对应于哪种数学表达？

options.label: 目标函数的梯度为零向量
目标函数的梯度与约束函数的梯度线性无关
目标函数与约束函数在该点的梯度张成一个二维空间
约束曲线的切线方向与目标函数的梯度方向正交

questions.analysis: 在最优点，任何沿约束曲线的微小移动都不能改变目标函数值。这意味着移动方向（即约束曲线的切线方向）必须与目标函数的最大变化方向（即梯度方向）垂直，两者的点积为零。这等价于目标函数的等高线与约束曲线相切。换言之，梯度不能有沿着约束切线方向的分量。这与梯度平行条件是等价的表述。选项A是无约束优化的条件；B和C则与约束最优无关或描述错误。

questions.question: （桥接预诊断）考虑一个单变量函数 f(x) = x^3 的图像。它看起来像一个被扭曲的滑梯，没有全局最低点，但有一个平坦的拐点。以下关于该图像凸性（Convexity) 的描述，哪个是正确的？

options.label: 它在所有地方都是凸的，因为形状是弯曲的
它在 x<0 时是凸的，在 x>0 时是凹的
它既不是全局凸函数也不是全局凹函数，因为它改变了弯曲方向
因为导数为零的点不是极小值点，所以它是凸的

questions.analysis: 函数 f(x)=x^3 的二阶导数为 6x。当 x<0 时，二阶导为负，函数是凹的；当 x>0 时，二阶导为正，函数是凸的。由于弯曲方向在 x=0 处发生了改变，它既不是全局凸函数，也不是全局凹函数。选项A的错误在于混淆了弯曲和凸性；选项B颠倒了凹凸区间；选项D的逻辑完全错误。这预诊了凸函数要求二阶导数非负这一关键判据。

actions.text: 这是一组关于“形成性测验：检查第一组场景并承接下一组知识点”的独立测验。通过拖动和观察，把可行区域和拉格朗日乘子的几何直觉建立起来了。现在，我们来做一个小测验，检验一下这些直觉是不是真的成了你自己的东西，同时也为需要探讨的“凸性”概念做个热身。
题目里既有对刚才场景实验的直接回顾，比如移动约束边界或者观察梯度平行，也有一些新的、需要你调用生活经验和空间想象力来回答的问题，它们会帮我们自然过渡到凸函数和凸集合的世界。不用紧张，像平时做思维实验一样去感受就好。我们开始吧。
大家可以重点关注一下第1题和第2题，它们直接把你在场景3和场景8中亲手操作得到的现象，提炼成了数学上更精炼的描述。你拖动滑块时看到的那个“只能在切点停下”的感觉，就藏在正确选项里。
而后面的几道“桥接预诊断”题，比如让你判断一个形状里任意两点的连线是否都在内部，或者想象两个不同山谷的地形，其实就在考验你对“凸”这个字的直观理解。不用怕犯错，这正是我们下一组场景要彻底弄明白的核心。
好了，给大家几分钟时间静下心来思考。当你们完成所有题目后，我们先一起看看那些在直觉和概念上最容易产生误解的地方，然后再专门聊一聊由这些题目引出来的那个既关键又迷人的话题——凸性。

scenes.title: 凸函数和凸集合

elements.content: 凸函数和凸集合
为什么凸性是优化的“圣杯”
凸集合：集合内任意两点连线都在集合内
凸函数：函数图像上任意两点连线都在图像上方

elements.html: f(θx+(1−θ)y)≤θf(x)+(1−θ)f(y)

elements.content: 核心优势：局部最优就是全局最优，没有陷阱点
图：凸集合与非凸集合的对比

actions.text: 本场景聚焦“凸函数和凸集合”。帮我们打通了从直觉到概念的路径。现在，我们终于要面对优化理论中真正的‘圣杯’了——为什么凸性是如此关键？它凭什么能给我们全局最优解的保证？
答案的起点，就在这两个核心定义里。首先看凸集合。顾名思义，一个集合是凸的，意味着集合里任意两点之间的连线，完完全全都还在这个集合内部。不会凹进去一块，也不会出现空洞。
看这张图就很直观。左边这个形状，你任意取两点连起来，线段都稳稳地落在里面，这就是凸集合。而右边这个，中间有凹陷，你总能找到一条连线会跑到集合外面去，那它就是非凸的。
理解了集合，再看凸函数。它的定义是，函数图像上任意两点之间的连线，都位于函数图像的上方。这个数学表达就是著名的琴生不等式：f(θx+(1-θ)y) 小于等于 θf(x) 加 (1-θ)f(y)。看起来有点抽象，对吧？
但如果用几何语言讲，就是函数图形是‘向下弯’的，像一个碗。你随便弹一条弦，函数图像都在弦的下方。这种形状，就具备了凸性。这也是为什么我们一直强调，先看到图形，再写公式。
而凸性最核心的优势，就在这里：局部最优就是全局最优。在一个凸的问题里，你一旦找到一个低谷点，它一定是整个区域里最低的那个点，绝不会有更深的‘陷阱’藏在别处。这让优化算法变得极其高效和可靠。

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});

<script>
// ============== Configuration & State ==============
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

let state = {
  running: false,
  ended: false,
  paused: false,
  x1: -1.0,
  x2: 1.0,
  theta: 0.5,
  funcType: 'convex', // 'convex' or 'nonconvex'
  animTheta: 0.5,
  animDirection: 1,
  time: 0
};

// ============== Functions ==============
function f_convex(x) { return x * x; }
function f_nonconvex(x) { return Math.sin(x * 1.5); }

function getFunc(type) {
  return type === 'convex' ? f_convex : f_nonconvex;
}

function getFuncLabel(type) {
  return type === 'convex' ? 'f(x) = x²' : 'f(x) = sin(1.5x)';
}

// ============== Canvas Sizing ==============
let W, H, dpr;

function resizeCanvas() {
  const container = canvas.parentElement;
  const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = rect.width;
  H = rect.height;
  canvas.width = W * dpr;
  canvas.height = H * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  draw();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

// ============== Coordinate Mapping ==============
const margin = { top: 50, bottom: 60, left: 50, right: 30 };
const xMin = -2.2, xMax = 2.2;
const yMin = -1.5, yMax = 2.2;

function toCanvasX(x) {
  return margin.left + (x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin) * (W - margin.left - margin.right);
}
function toCanvasY(y) {
  return margin.top + (1 - (y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)) * (H - margin.top - margin.bottom);
}
function fromCanvasX(cx) {
  return xMin + (cx - margin.left) / (W - margin.left - margin.right) * (xMax - xMin);
}

// ============== Drawing ==============
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#030712';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  
  const f = getFunc(state.funcType);
  const funcType = state.funcType;
  
  // Grid
  drawGrid();
  
  // Axes
  drawAxes();
  
  // Function curve
  drawCurve(f);
  
  // Secant line
  drawSecant(f);
  
  // Points
  drawPoints(f);
  
  // Difference annotation
  drawDifference(f);
}

function drawGrid() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  
  for (let x = Math.ceil(xMin); x <= Math.floor(xMax); x++) {
    const cx = toCanvasX(x);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, margin.top);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, H - margin.bottom);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  for (let y = Math.ceil(yMin); y <= Math.floor(yMax); y++) {
    const cy = toCanvasY(y);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(margin.left, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(W - margin.right, cy);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawAxes() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  
  // X axis
  const y0 = toCanvasY(0);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(margin.left, y0);
  ctx.lineTo(W - margin.right, y0);
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Y axis
  const x0 = toCanvasX(0);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0, margin.top);
  ctx.lineTo(x0, H - margin.bottom);
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Labels
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6)';
  ctx.font = '11px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  
  for (let x = Math.ceil(xMin); x <= Math.floor(xMax); x++) {
    if (x === 0) continue;
    const cx = toCanvasX(x);
    ctx.fillText(x, cx, y0 + 18);
  }
  
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (let y = Math.ceil(yMin); y <= Math.floor(yMax); y++) {
    if (y === 0) continue;
    const cy = toCanvasY(y);
    ctx.fillText(y, x0 - 8, cy + 4);
  }
  
  // Axis labels
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5)';
  ctx.font = '13px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('x', W - margin.right + 15, y0 + 5);
  ctx.fillText('f(x)', x0, margin.top - 10);
}

function drawCurve(f) {
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#facc15';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(250, 204, 20, 0.3)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  
  ctx.beginPath();
  let first = true;
  const steps = 500;
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const x = xMin + (xMax - xMin) * i / steps;
    const y = f(x);
    if (y < yMin - 0.5 || y > yMax + 0.5) {
      first = true;
      continue;
    }
    const cx = toCanvasX(x);
    const cy = toCanvasY(y);
    if (first) {
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
      first = false;
    } else {
      ctx.lineTo(cx, cy);
    }
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawSecant(f) {
  const fx1 = f(state.x1);
  const fx2 = f(state.x2);
  
  // Extend secant line beyond points
  const ext = 0.5;
  const xL = Math.max(xMin, state.x1 - ext * (state.x2 - state.x1));
  const xR = Math.min(xMax, state.x2 + ext * (state.x2 - state.x1));
  
  const slope = (state.x2 !== state.x1) ? (fx2 - fx1) / (state.x2 - state.x1) : 0;
  const yL = fx1 + slope * (xL - state.x1);
  const yR = fx1 + slope * (xR - state.x1);
  
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#22d3ee';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 4]);
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.3)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(toCanvasX(xL), toCanvasY(yL));
  ctx.lineTo(toCanvasX(xR), toCanvasY(yR));
  ctx.stroke();
  
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
}

function drawPoints(f) {
  const fx1 = f(state.x1);
  const fx2 = f(state.x2);
  const theta = state.theta;
  const xstar = theta * state.x1 + (1 - theta) * state.x2;
  const fxstar = f(xstar);
  const secantY = theta * fx1 + (1 - theta) * fx2;
  
  // Vertical dashed line from secant point to curve point
  const cxstar = toCanvasX(xstar);
  const cySecant = toCanvasY(secantY);
  const cyCurve = toCanvasY(fxstar);
  
  // Difference line
  const diff = secantY - fxstar;
  const isConvex = diff >= -0.001;
  
  if (Math.abs(diff) > 0.001) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = isConvex ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cxstar, cySecant);
    ctx.lineTo(cxstar, cyCurve);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    
    // Arrow heads
    const arrowDir = diff > 0 ? -1 : 1;
    const arrowY = diff > 0 ? cySecant + 10 : cyCurve + 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = isConvex ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cxstar, arrowY);
    ctx.lineTo(cxstar - 5, arrowY + arrowDir * 8);
    ctx.lineTo(cxstar + 5, arrowY + arrowDir * 8);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Label on the difference line
    const midY = (cySecant + cyCurve) / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = isConvex ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Δ=' + diff.toFixed(3), cxstar + 8, midY + 4);
  }
  
  // Point x1
  drawPoint(state.x1, fx1, '#3b82f6', 'x₁');
  
  // Point x2
  drawPoint(state.x2, fx2, '#ef4444', 'x₂');
  
  // Point on curve at x*
  drawPoint(xstar, fxstar, '#a855f7', 'f(x*)');
  
  // Point on secant at x*
  drawPoint(xstar, secantY, '#22c55e', 'secant');
  
  // Labels with lines
  drawLabel(state.x1, fx1, 'x₁=' + state.x1.toFixed(2), '#3b82f6', -20, -30);
  drawLabel(state.x2, fx2, 'x₂=' + state.x2.toFixed(2), '#ef4444', 10, -30);
}

function drawPoint(x, y, color, label) {
  const cx = toCanvasX(x);
  const cy = toCanvasY(y);
  
  // Outer glow
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = color + '33';
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Inner point
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.shadowColor = color;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  
  // White border
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawLabel(x, y, text, color, offsetX, offsetY) {
  const cx = toCanvasX(x) + offsetX;
  const cy = toCanvasY(y) + offsetY;
  
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  
  // Background
  const metrics = ctx.measureText(text);
  const tw = metrics.width;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
  ctx.fillRect(cx - 3, cy - 12, tw + 6, 16);
  
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(text, cx, cy);
}

function drawDifference(f) {
  // This is handled in drawPoints now
}

// ============== Slider Handlers ==============
function setupSliders() {
  const x1Slider = document.getElementById('x1_pos-slider');
  const x2Slider = document.getElementById('x2_pos-slider');
  const thetaSlider = document.getElementById('theta-slider');
  
  x1Slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    state.x1 = parseFloat(this.value);
    ensureOrder();
    document.getElementById('x1_pos-display').textContent = state.x1.toFixed(2);
    updateReadings();
    draw();
  });
  
  x2Slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    state.x2 = parseFloat(this.value);
    ensureOrder();
    document.getElementById('x2_pos-display').textContent = state.x2.toFixed(2);
    updateReadings();
    draw();
  });
  
  thetaSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
    state.theta = parseFloat(this.value);
    state.animTheta = state.theta;
    document.getElementById('theta-display').textContent = state.theta.toFixed(2);
    updateReadings();
    draw();
  });
}

function ensureOrder() {
  if (state.x1 > state.x2) {
    const temp = state.x1;
    state.x1 = state.x2;
    state.x2 = temp;
    document.getElementById('x1_pos-slider').value = state.x1;
    document.getElementById('x2_pos-slider').value = state.x2;
    document.getElementById('x1_pos-display').textContent = state.x1.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById('x2_pos-display').textContent = state.x2.toFixed(2);
  }
}

// ============== Readings Update ==============
function updateReadings() {
  const f = getFunc(state.funcType);
  const fx1 = f(state.x1);
  const fx2 = f(state.x2);
  const xstar = state.theta * state.x1 + (1 - state.theta) * state.x2;
  const fxstar = f(xstar);
  const secantY = state.theta * fx1 + (1 - state.theta) * fx2;
  const diff = secantY - fxstar;
  
  document.getElementById('reading-fx1').textContent = fx1.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('reading-fx2').textContent = fx2.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('reading-xstar').textContent = xstar.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('reading-fxstar').textContent = fxstar.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('reading-secant').textContent = secantY.toFixed(3);
  
  const diffEl = document.getElementById('reading-diff');
  diffEl.textContent = (diff >= 0 ? '+' : '') + diff.toFixed(3);
  
  const statusEl = document.getElementById('convexity-status');
  const readingsPanel = document.getElementById('readings-panel');
  
  if (diff >= -0.001) {
    diffEl.className = 'font-bold text-lg text-green-400';
    statusEl.className = 'mt-2 text-center text-sm font-semibold py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-green-900/40 text-green-300 border border-green-600/30 ok-pulse';
    statusEl.innerHTML = '✓ 凸性成立 (Convexity holds)';
    readingsPanel.style.borderColor = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3)';
  } else {
    diffEl.className = 'font-bold text-lg text-red-400';
    statusEl.className = 'mt-2 text-center text-sm font-semibold py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-900/40 text-red-300 border border-red-600/30 warn-pulse';
    statusEl.innerHTML = '⚠ 凸性不成立 (Non-convex!) 差值为负!';
    readingsPanel.style.borderColor = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5)';
  }
}

// ============== Function Type Toggle ==============
function setFunctionType(type) {
  state.funcType = type;
  
  const convexBtn = document.getElementById('convex-btn');
  const nonconvexBtn = document.getElementById('nonconvex-btn');
  const formulaEl = document.getElementById('func-formula');
  
  if (type === 'convex') {
    convexBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm transition-all bg-green-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-green-600/30';
    nonconvexBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm transition-all bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-600';
    formulaEl.textContent = 'f(x) = x²';
  } else {
    nonconvexBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm transition-all bg-red-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30';
    convexBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-sm transition-all bg-gray-700 text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-600';
    formulaEl.textContent = 'f(x) = sin(1.5x)';
  }
  
  updateReadings();
  draw();
}

// ============== Main Button Logic ==============
function handleMainButton() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
    state.running = true;
    state.ended = false;
    updateButtonState('running');
    animate();
  } else if (state.running) {
    state.running = false;
    state.paused = true;
    updateButtonState('paused');
  } else {
    state.running = true;
    state.paused = false;
    state.ended = false;
    updateButtonState('running');
    animate();
  }
}

function updateButtonState(status) {
  const btn = document.getElementById('main-btn');
  const dot = document.getElementById('state-dot');
  const text = document.getElementById('state-text');
  
  switch(status) {
    case 'running':
      btn.innerHTML = '⏸ 暂停';
      btn.className = 'flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-amber-600/30 min-h-[44px]';
      dot.className = 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-green-400 animate-pulse';
      text.textContent = '运行中 Running';
      break;
    case 'paused':
      btn.innerHTML = '▶ 继续';
      btn.className = 'flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 min-h-[44px]';
      dot.className = 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-400';
      text.textContent = '已暂停 Paused';
      break;
    case 'ready':
      btn.innerHTML = '▶ 启动动画';
      btn.className = 'flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 min-h-[44px]';
      dot.className = 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-gray-500';
      text.textContent = '就绪 Ready';
      break;
    case 'ended':
      btn.innerHTML = '↻ 重新开始';
      btn.className = 'flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-lg shadow-green-600/30 min-h-[44px]';
      dot.className = 'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-400';
      text.textContent = '已结束 Ended';
      break;
  }
}

// ============== Reset ==============
function resetSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.paused = false;
  state.x1 = -1.0;
  state.x2 = 1.0;
  state.theta = 0.5;
  state.animTheta = 0.5;
  state.time = 0;
  
  document.getElementById('x1_pos-slider').value = state.x1;
  document.getElementById('x2_pos-slider').value = state.x2;
  document.getElementById('theta-slider').value = state.theta;
  document.getElementById('x1_pos-display').textContent = state.x1.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('x2_pos-display').textContent = state.x2.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('theta-display').textContent = state.theta.toFixed(2);
  
  updateReadings();
  updateButtonState('ready');
  draw();
}

// ============== Animation ==============
let animFrameId = null;

function animate() {
  if (!state.running) return;
  
  state.time += 0.016;
  
  // Animate theta smoothly
  state.animTheta += 0.005 * state.animDirection;
  
  if (state.animTheta >= 1) {
    state.animTheta = 1;
    state.animDirection = -1;
  } else if (state.animTheta <= 0) {
    state.animTheta = 0;
    state.animDirection = 1;
  }
  
  state.theta = state.animTheta;
  document.getElementById('theta-slider').value = state.theta;
  document.getElementById('theta-display').textContent = state.theta.toFixed(2);
  
  updateReadings();
  draw();
  
  animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

// ============== Presets ==============
function applyPreset(index) {
  const presets = [
    { x1_pos: -1.0, x2_pos: 1.0, theta: 0.5 },
    { x1_pos: -1.5, x2_pos: 1.5, theta: 0.8 },
    { x1_pos: -1.8, x2_pos: 1.8, theta: 0.2 }
  ];
  
  const preset = presets[index];
  if (!preset) return;
  
  state.x1 = preset.x1_pos;
  state.x2 = preset.x2_pos;
  state.theta = preset.theta;
  state.animTheta = preset.theta;
  
  document.getElementById('x1_pos-slider').value = state.x1;
  document.getElementById('x2_pos-slider').value = state.x2;
  document.getElementById('theta-slider').value = state.theta;
  document.getElementById('x1_pos-display').textContent = state.x1.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('x2_pos-display').textContent = state.x2.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('theta-display').textContent = state.theta.toFixed(2);
  
  // Stop animation when applying preset
  if (state.running) {
    state.running = false;
    state.paused = false;
    if (animFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId);
    updateButtonState('ready');
  }
  
  updateReadings();
  draw();
}

// ============== Keyboard Shortcuts ==============
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.code === 'Space') {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleMainButton();
  } else if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') {
    e.preventDefault();
    resetSimulation();
  }
});

// ============== postMessage Listener ==============
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  const { type, target, state: msgState, content } = event.data || {};

  switch (type) {
    case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE':
      if (msgState) {
        Object.entries(msgState).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          const slider = document.getElementById(key + '-slider') || document.querySelector('[data-var="' + key + '"]');
          if (slider) {
            slider.value = value;
            slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          }
        });
      }
      break;

    case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT':
      const highlightEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (highlightEl) {
        highlightEl.style.outline = '3px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8)';
        highlightEl.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
        highlightEl.style.animation = 'pulse-highlight 2s infinite';
        setTimeout(() => {
          highlightEl.style.outline = '';
          highlightEl.style.animation = '';
        }, 3000);
      }
      break;

    case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT':
      const annotateEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (annotateEl && content) {
        const rect = annotateEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
        tooltip.className = 'teacher-annotation';
        tooltip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:' + (rect.top - 40) + 'px; left:' + rect.left + 'px; background:rgba(139,92,246,0.95); color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; z-index:1000; animation:fadeIn 0.3s;';
        tooltip.textContent = content;
        document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
        setTimeout(() => tooltip.remove(), 4000);
      }
      break;

    case 'REVEAL_ELEMENT':
      const revealEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (revealEl) {
        revealEl.style.display = '';
        revealEl.style.opacity = '1';
      }
      break;
  }
});

// ============== CSS Animations ==============
const style = document.createElement('style');
style.textContent = '@keyframes pulse-highlight { 0%, 100% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8); } 50% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); } } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }';
document.head.appendChild(style);

// ============== Initialize ==============
function init() {
  resizeCanvas();
  setupSliders();
  updateReadings();
  draw();
}

// Use ResizeObserver for better resize handling
const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
  resizeCanvas();
});
resizeObserver.observe(canvas.parentElement);

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.title: 凸函数与凸集合 - Convex Functions and Convex Sets
widgetConfig.description: 通过割线实验验证凸性：在曲线上任取两点连线，观察 f(θx₁+(1-θ)x₂) 与 θf(x₁)+(1-θ)f(x₂) 的关系。凸函数满足 f(θx₁+(1-θ)x₂) ≤ θf(x₁)+(1-θ)f(x₂)，差值始终 ≥ 0。

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“凸函数和凸集合：拖动实验”。凸性最核心的优势是局部最优即全局最优。那么，怎么判断一个函数是不是凸的呢？我们来通过这个割线实验，亲手验证一下。

actions.content: 拖动 x₁ 和 x₂ 可以改变割线的两个端点位置。

actions.text: 屏幕上这个形状像碗一样的，是一个凸函数。请试着拖动 x₁ 或 x₂ 的滑块，在曲线上任选两点。

actions.content: 将两点大致对称地放到曲线的两侧。

actions.text: 看，两点之间连了一条割线。现在我们把权重 θ 固定在 0.5，也就是观察中点位置。面板上显示，曲线上中点的函数值 f(中点)，总是小于等于割线中点的值，差值大于等于零。你可以在脑子里想一下：这意味着什么？

actions.content: 差值 ≥ 0 时，凸性成立；差值为负，说明函数在这里是‘下凹’的。

actions.text: 现在，请试着切换到非凸函数来对比。

actions.content: 这是非凸函数，请注意差值面板的变化。

actions.text: 看到红色警告了吗？对于非凸函数，你能找到一些位置，让割线跑到曲线的下面去，差值变成了负数。所以，凸性的本质就是：函数图形上的任意一条弦，都位于图形的上方。试着拖动端点，看看能不能在非凸函数上，也找到差值大于等于零的位置呢？这是一个很好的思考题。

actions.content: 使用这个开关，在凸函数与非凸函数之间来回对比，加深印象。

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">
{
  "title": "凸函数和凸集合：关系图",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "n1",
      "label": "凸性\nConvexity",
      "icon": "🎯",
      "details": "凸性(Convexity)是优化理论的核心概念。其核心性质在于：两点之间的线段上任意点的函数值不大于端点函数值的线性插值。它同时存在于函数空间和集合空间。"
    },
    {
      "id": "n2",
      "label": "凸函数\nConvex Function",
      "icon": "📈",
      "details": "Jensen不等式：f(θx + (1-θ)y) ≤ θf(x) + (1-θ)f(y)，其中 θ ∈ [0,1]。几何直觉：函数图像上任意两点的连线总是在图像的上方。这是凸性在函数空间的体现。"
    },
    {
      "id": "n3",
      "label": "凸集合\nConvex Set",
      "icon": "📐",
      "details": "定义：集合 C 中任意两点的连线仍在 C 内，即 θx + (1-θ)y ∈ C，∀ x,y∈C, θ∈[0,1]。几何直觉：集合中没有\"凹陷\"。这是凸性在集合空间的体现。"
    },
    {
      "id": "n4",
      "label": "Epigraph\n(上方图)",
      "icon": "🌉",
      "details": "Epigraph f = {(x, t) | f(x) ≤ t}。关键定理：f 是凸函数 ⟺ epi f 是凸集合。Epigraph 正是连接函数空间与集合空间的桥梁——它将凸函数\"翻译\"为凸集合。"
    },
    {
      "id": "n5",
      "label": "Hessian 判别法\n二阶条件",
      "icon": "📊",
      "details": "若 f 二阶可微，则 f 为凸函数 ⟺ ∇²f(x) ⪰ 0（半正定）。这是判定凸函数的实用工具。直观理解：函数在每个方向上的曲率都非负，即不会\"向下弯\"。"

  const ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

  // Compute SVG viewBox
  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;

    minY = Math.min(minY, p.y - NODE_H/2 - 40);

    maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.y + NODE_H/2 + 40);

  const vbH = maxY - minY + pad*2;

  marker.setAttribute('markerWidth', '8');
