  const arrowPath = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
  arrowPath.setAttribute('d', 'M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 Z');
  arrowPath.setAttribute('fill', '#484f58');
  marker.appendChild(arrowPath);
  defs.appendChild(marker);

  // Visible arrow marker
  const markerV = document.createElementNS(ns, 'marker');
  markerV.setAttribute('id', 'arrow-v');
  markerV.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 10 10');
  markerV.setAttribute('refX', '9');
  markerV.setAttribute('refY', '5');
  markerV.setAttribute('markerWidth', '8');
  markerV.setAttribute('markerHeight', '8');
  markerV.setAttribute('orient', 'auto');
  const arrowPathV = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
  arrowPathV.setAttribute('d', 'M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 Z');
  arrowPathV.setAttribute('fill', '#58a6ff');
  markerV.appendChild(arrowPathV);
  defs.appendChild(markerV);

  // Glow filter
  const filter = document.createElementNS(ns, 'filter');
  filter.setAttribute('id', 'glow');
  const blur = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feGaussianBlur');
  blur.setAttribute('stdDeviation', '3');
  blur.setAttribute('result', 'coloredBlur');
  filter.appendChild(blur);
  const merge = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feMerge');
  const mn1 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feMergeNode');
  mn1.setAttribute('in', 'coloredBlur');
  merge.appendChild(mn1);
  const mn2 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feMergeNode');
  mn2.setAttribute('in', 'SourceGraphic');
  merge.appendChild(mn2);
  filter.appendChild(merge);
  defs.appendChild(filter);

  svg.appendChild(defs);

  // Edge group (drawn first, behind nodes)
  const edgeGroup = document.createElementNS(ns, 'g');
  edgeGroup.setAttribute('id', 'edges');
  svg.appendChild(edgeGroup);

  // Node group
  const nodeGroup = document.createElementNS(ns, 'g');
  nodeGroup.setAttribute('id', 'nodes');
  svg.appendChild(nodeGroup);

  // Helper: get edge connection points
  function getEdgePoints(from, to) {
    const fx = layout[from].x, fy = layout[from].y;
    const tx = layout[to].x, ty = layout[to].y;
    const dx = tx - fx, dy = ty - fy;
    let sx, sy, ex, ey;

    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
      sx = fx;
      sy = dy > 0 ? fy + NODE_H/2 : fy - NODE_H/2;
      ex = tx;
      ey = dy > 0 ? ty - NODE_H/2 - ARROW_OFF : ty + NODE_H/2 + ARROW_OFF;
    } else {
      sx = dx > 0 ? fx + NODE_W/2 : fx - NODE_W/2;
      sy = fy;
      ex = dx > 0 ? tx - NODE_W/2 - ARROW_OFF : tx + NODE_W/2 + ARROW_OFF;
      ey = ty;
    }
    return { sx, sy, ex, ey };
  }

  // Create edges
  const edgeElements = {};
  edges.forEach((e, i) => {
    const { sx, sy, ex, ey } = getEdgePoints(e.from, e.to);
    const g = document.createElementNS(ns, 'g');
    g.setAttribute('class', 'edge-group');
    g.setAttribute('data-from', e.from);
    g.setAttribute('data-to', e.to);

    const path = document.createElementNS(ns, 'path');
    path.setAttribute('d', `M ${sx} ${sy} L ${ex} ${ey}`);
    path.setAttribute('class', 'edge-path hidden');
    path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow)');
    path.setAttribute('id', `edge-${e.from}-${e.to}`);
    g.appendChild(path);

    // Edge label
    const mx = (sx + ex) / 2;
    const my = (sy + ey) / 2;
    const label = document.createElementNS(ns, 'text');
    label.setAttribute('x', mx);
    label.setAttribute('y', my - 8);
    label.setAttribute('class', 'edge-label hidden');
    label.setAttribute('id', `elabel-${e.from}-${e.to}`);
    label.textContent = e.label;
    g.appendChild(label);

    edgeGroup.appendChild(g);
    edgeElements[`${e.from}-${e.to}`] = { path, label, group: g };
  });

  // Create nodes
  const nodeElements = {};
  const nodeMap = {};
  nodes.forEach(n => {
    nodeMap[n.id] = n;
    const p = layout[n.id];
    const g = document.createElementNS(ns, 'g');
    g.setAttribute('class', 'node-group hidden');
    g.setAttribute('data-id', n.id);
    g.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${p.x}, ${p.y})`);

    // Rect
    const rect = document.createElementNS(ns, 'rect');
    rect.setAttribute('x', -NODE_W/2);
    rect.setAttribute('y', -NODE_H/2);
    rect.setAttribute('width', NODE_W);
    rect.setAttribute('height', NODE_H);
    rect.setAttribute('class', 'node-rect');
    g.appendChild(rect);

    // Icon
    const icon = document.createElementNS(ns, 'text');
    icon.setAttribute('x', -NODE_W/2 + 18);
    icon.setAttribute('y', 2);
    icon.setAttribute('class', 'node-icon');
    icon.textContent = n.icon;
    g.appendChild(icon);

    // Label lines
    const lines = n.label.split('\n');
    lines.forEach((line, li) => {
      const t = document.createElementNS(ns, 'text');
      t.setAttribute('x', 10);
      t.setAttribute('y', -6 + li * 16);
      if (li === 0) {
        t.setAttribute('class', 'node-label');
      } else {
        t.setAttribute('class', 'node-label-en');
      }
      t.textContent = line;
      g.appendChild(t);
    });

    // Click handler
    g.addEventListener('click', () => selectNode(n.id));

    nodeGroup.appendChild(g);
    nodeElements[n.id] = g;
  });

  // State
  var currentStep = 0;
  let selectedNode = null;

  // Build sidebar cards
  const sidebarContent = document.getElementById('sidebar-content');
  nodes.forEach(n => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'detail-card';
    card.id = `card-${n.id}`;
    card.innerHTML = `<h3>${n.icon} ${n.label.replace('\n', ' / ')}</h3><p>${n.details}</p>`;
    sidebarContent.appendChild(card);
  });

  // Reveal logic
  function revealNode(id) {
    const el = nodeElements[id];
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
    el.classList.add('reveal-pulse');
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('reveal-pulse'), 600);

    // Reveal connected edges
    edges.forEach(e => {
      if (e.from === id || e.to === id) {
        const key = `${e.from}-${e.to}`;
        const ep = edgeElements[key];
        if (ep) {
          // Check both connected nodes are visible
          const fromVisible = !nodeElements[e.from].classList.contains('hidden');
          const toVisible = !nodeElements[e.to].classList.contains('hidden');
          if (fromVisible && toVisible) {
            ep.path.classList.remove('hidden');
            ep.path.classList.add('visible');
            ep.path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-v)');
            ep.label.classList.remove('hidden');
            ep.label.classList.add('visible');
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function hideNode(id) {
    const el = nodeElements[id];
    el.classList.add('hidden');
    el.classList.remove('selected');
    // Hide connected edges
    edges.forEach(e => {
      if (e.from === id || e.to === id) {
        const key = `${e.from}-${e.to}`;
        const ep = edgeElements[key];
        if (ep) {
          ep.path.classList.add('hidden');
          ep.path.classList.remove('visible');
          ep.path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow)');
          ep.label.classList.add('hidden');
          ep.label.classList.remove('visible');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function updateState() {
    revealOrder.forEach((id, i) => {
      if (i < currentStep) {
        revealNode(id);
      } else {
        hideNode(id);
      }
    });

    // Update buttons
    document.getElementById('prev-btn').disabled = currentStep <= 0;
    document.getElementById('next-btn').disabled = currentStep >= revealOrder.length;
    document.getElementById('step-info').textContent = `步骤 ${currentStep} / ${revealOrder.length}`;

    // Auto-select current revealed node
    if (currentStep > 0 && currentStep <= revealOrder.length) {
      selectNode(revealOrder[currentStep - 1]);
    } else {
      clearSelection();
    }
  }

  function selectNode(id) {
    clearSelection();
    selectedNode = id;
    nodeElements[id].classList.add('selected');
    const card = document.getElementById(`card-${id}`);
    if (card) {
      card.classList.add('active');
      card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }
  }

  function clearSelection() {
    if (selectedNode) {
      nodeElements[selectedNode]?.classList.remove('selected');
      document.getElementById(`card-${selectedNode}`)?.classList.remove('active');
    }
    selectedNode = null;
  }

  // Nav buttons
  document.getElementById('next-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentStep < revealOrder.length) {
      currentStep++;
      updateState();
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('prev-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentStep > 0) {
      currentStep--;
      updateState();
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    currentStep = 0;
    updateState();
  });

  // Sidebar toggle
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  document.getElementById('toggle-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  });
  document.getElementById('mobile-toggle').addEventListener('click', () => {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  });

  // Keyboard navigation
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      if (currentStep < revealOrder.length) { currentStep++; updateState(); }
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      if (currentStep > 0) { currentStep--; updateState(); }
    }
  });

  // Initial state: reveal first node
  currentStep = 1;
  updateState();
})();
</script>

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“凸函数和凸集合：关系图”。也体会到了非凸函数哪里会“凹陷”下去。现在我们把视角拉高一点，用一张关系图来把这些概念串起来。

actions.content: 这是中心节点：凸性 (Convexity)。

actions.text: 图的中心就是“凸性”。它像一个枢纽，左边连着凸函数的定义，右边连着凸集合的定义。我们刚刚拖动实验里判断的，其实就是 Jensen 不等式的二维直观版本。

actions.content: 凸函数定义分支，包括 Jensen 不等式和 Hessian 判别法。
凸集合定义分支。

actions.text: 注意看，这两个分支之间有一条很特别的连线——Epigraph，也就是函数的“上方图”。这正是连接函数与集合的桥梁：一个函数是凸函数，当且仅当它的 Epigraph 是一个凸集合。

actions.content: 揭示 Epigraph 节点及其连接线。

actions.text: 所以大家刚才在琢磨的“凸性如何把函数性质转化为集合性质”，答案就在这条连线上。当你看到一个凸函数的 Epigraph，它就是一个实心的、没有凹陷的凸集合，这为我们后面用几何方法求解优化问题打下了基础。

            --primary: #4f46e5;
            --success: #10b981;
            --danger: #ef4444;
            --bg: #f8fafc;

        }

            font-size: 2rem;

            z-index: 150;
        }

        .tooltip {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #64748b;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<body>

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">
{
  "type": "game",
  "gameType": "sorting",
  "correctPoints": 10,
  "speedBonus": 5,
  "shapes": [
    {"id": "parabola", "type": "convex", "name": "标准抛物线 $x^2$", "desc": "完美的碗状结构"},
    {"id": "wavy-bowl", "type": "nonconvex", "name": "波动碗底", "desc": "局部有坑！两点连线会穿出函数外"},
    {"id": "triangle", "type": "convex", "name": "三角集合", "desc": "任何两点连线都在内部"},
    {"id": "star", "type": "nonconvex", "name": "星形集合", "desc": "凹角处连线会跑到外面"},
    {"id": "abs", "type": "convex", "name": "绝对值 $|x|$", "desc": "虽然有尖角，但依然是凸的"},
    {"id": "saddle", "type": "nonconvex", "name": "三点波动", "desc": "多峰函数是非凸的典型"},
    {"id": "crescent", "type": "nonconvex", "name": "月牙集合", "desc": "明显的非凸形状"},
    {"id": "circle", "type": "convex", "name": "圆形集合", "desc": "经典的凸集合"},
    {"id": "step", "type": "nonconvex", "name": "阶梯函数", "desc": "不连续或不平滑的波动"},
    {"id": "semi", "type": "convex", "name": "指数函数 $e^x$", "desc": "单调且二阶导大于零"}
  ]
}
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
    let score = 0;
    let level = 1;
    let combo = 0;
    let gameActive = false;
    let currentCardData = null;
    let achievements = new Set();
    
    const gameBoard = document.getElementById('game-board');
    const scoreEl = document.getElementById('score');
    const levelEl = document.getElementById('level');
    const comboEl = document.getElementById('combo');

    const shapeData = [
        { id: 1, type: 'convex', name: '二次函数 $x^2$', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(let x=-50; x<=50; x++) ctx.lineTo(x+110, (x*x)/25 + 100);
            ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 2, type: 'nonconvex', name: '波动碗 (Local Pit)', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(let x=-50; x<=50; x++) {
                const y = (x*x)/25 + Math.sin(x/5)*15 + 100;
                ctx.lineTo(x+110, y);
            }
            ctx.stroke();
            // Draw visual hint: a line segment that fails
            ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ef4444';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(85, 95); ctx.lineTo(135, 95); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]); ctx.strokeStyle = '#4f46e5';
        }},
        { id: 3, type: 'convex', name: '凸多边形', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(110, 50); ctx.lineTo(160, 100); ctx.lineTo(140, 150); ctx.lineTo(80, 150); ctx.lineTo(60, 100);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 4, type: 'nonconvex', name: '非凸集合 (星形)', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(let i=0; i<5; i++) {
                ctx.lineTo(110 + 60*Math.cos(i*4*Math.PI/5 - Math.PI/2), 100 + 60*Math.sin(i*4*Math.PI/5 - Math.PI/2));
            }
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 5, type: 'convex', name: '绝对值函数 $|x|$', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(60, 50); ctx.lineTo(110, 150); ctx.lineTo(160, 50);
            ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 6, type: 'nonconvex', name: '指数波动', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(let x=-50; x<=50; x++) ctx.lineTo(x+110, Math.pow(1.1, x) + Math.cos(x/3)*20 + 100);
            ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 7, type: 'convex', name: '半圆集合 (下部)', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(110, 80, 60, 0, Math.PI);
            ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 8, type: 'nonconvex', name: '月牙形 (Crescent)', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(110, 100, 60, 0, Math.PI*2);
            ctx.arc(130, 100, 50, 0, Math.PI*2, true);
            ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 9, type: 'convex', name: '常数函数 $f(x)=c$', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(60, 100); ctx.lineTo(160, 100);
            ctx.stroke();
        }},
        { id: 10, type: 'nonconvex', name: '三次函数 $x^3$', draw: (ctx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            for(let x=-40; x<=40; x++) ctx.lineTo(x+110, Math.pow(x, 3)/1000 + 100);
            ctx.stroke();
        }}
    ];

    let currentCard = null;
    let startX, startY, moveX, moveY;

    window.startGame = () => {
        score = 0;
        level = 1;
        combo = 0;
        gameActive = true;
        achievements.clear();
        document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('result-screen').classList.add('hidden');
        updateHUD();
        spawnCard();
    };

    function updateHUD() {
        scoreEl.innerText = score;
        levelEl.innerText = level;
        comboEl.innerText = combo;
    }

    function spawnCard() {
        if (level > 10) return endGame();
        
        // Remove old card if exists
        if (currentCard) currentCard.remove();

        const data = shapeData[level - 1];
        currentCardData = data;

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'card';
        card.innerHTML = `
            <canvas id="card-canvas" width="220" height="180"></canvas>
            <div class="card-label">${data.name}</div>
            <div class="tooltip">拖动分类：左(凸) / 右(非凸)</div>
        `;
        
        gameBoard.appendChild(card);
        currentCard = card;

        const canvas = card.querySelector('canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#4f46e5';
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.1)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        data.draw(ctx);

        setupDrag(card);
    }

    function setupDrag(card) {
        const handleStart = (e) => {
            if (!gameActive) return;
            const touch = e.type === 'touchstart' ? e.touches[0] : e;
            startX = touch.clientX;
            startY = touch.clientY;
            card.style.transition = 'none';
            card.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        };

        const handleMove = (e) => {
            if (!startX || !gameActive) return;
            const touch = e.type === 'touchmove' ? e.touches[0] : e;
            moveX = touch.clientX - startX;
            moveY = touch.clientY - startY;

            // Rotate based on horizontal move
            const rotate = moveX * 0.1;
            card.style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px) rotate(${rotate}deg)`;

            // Highlight zones
            document.getElementById('zone-convex').className = 'zone' + (moveX < -80 ? ' active-convex' : '');
            document.getElementById('zone-nonconvex').className = 'zone' + (moveX > 80 ? ' active-nonconvex' : '');
        };

        const handleEnd = () => {
            if (!startX || !gameActive) return;
            
            const threshold = 120;
            if (moveX < -threshold) {
                checkChoice('convex');
            } else if (moveX > threshold) {
                checkChoice('nonconvex');
            } else {
                // Snap back
                card.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)';
                card.style.transform = 'translate(0,0) rotate(0)';
            }

            startX = null;
            document.getElementById('zone-convex').className = 'zone';
            document.getElementById('zone-nonconvex').className = 'zone';
        };

        card.addEventListener('mousedown', handleStart);
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMove);
        window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleEnd);

        card.addEventListener('touchstart', handleStart);
        window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleMove);
        window.addEventListener('touchend', handleEnd);
    }

    function checkChoice(choice) {
        const isCorrect = choice === currentCardData.type;

        if (isCorrect) {
            score += 10 + (combo * 2);
            combo++;
            level++;
            
            // Fly away animation
            currentCard.style.transition = 'all 0.4s ease-in';
            currentCard.style.transform = `translate(${choice === 'convex' ? -600 : 600}px, 200px) scale(0.1)`;
            currentCard.style.opacity = '0';

            showComboEffect(choice === 'convex' ? -100 : 100);
            
            if (combo === 5) showAchievement('🔥 五连绝世', 'combo5');
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                updateHUD();
                spawnCard();
            }, 400);

        } else {
            combo = 0;
            updateHUD();
            // Repulsion vibration
            currentCard.classList.add('shake');
            setTimeout(() => {
                currentCard.classList.remove('shake');
                currentCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s';
                currentCard.style.transform = 'translate(0,0)';
            }, 500);
        }
    }

    function showComboEffect(xOffset) {
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'combo-text';
        el.innerText = `+${10 + (combo-1)*2}`;
        el.style.left = `calc(50% + ${xOffset}px)`;
        el.style.top = '40%';
        document.body.appendChild(el);

        // Animate
        let opacity = 1;
        let y = 40;
        function anim() {
            opacity -= 0.02;
            y -= 1;
            el.style.opacity = opacity;
            el.style.top = `${y}%`;
            if (opacity > 0) requestAnimationFrame(anim);
            else el.remove();
        }
        anim();
    }

    function showAchievement(name, id) {
        if (achievements.has(id)) return;
        achievements.add(id);
        
        const toast = document.getElementById('achievement-toast');
        document.getElementById('toast-name').innerText = name;
        toast.classList.add('show');
        setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
    }

    function endGame() {
        gameActive = false;
        const resultScreen = document.getElementById('result-screen');
        resultScreen.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('result-text').innerText = `最终得分: ${score}`;
        
        const list = document.getElementById('achievements-list');
        list.innerHTML = '<h3>达成荣誉:</h3>';
        if (score > 100) list.innerHTML += '<div>🥇 凸优化大师</div>';
        else if (score > 50) list.innerHTML += '<div>🥈 直觉敏锐者</div>';
        else list.innerHTML += '<div>🥉 基础练习生</div>';

        // Save high score
        const high = localStorage.getItem('convex_high_score') || 0;
        if (score > high) {
            localStorage.setItem('convex_high_score', score);
            list.innerHTML += `<div style="color: gold; margin-top:10px;">✨ 创纪录新高! (原纪录: ${high})</div>`;
        }
    }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“凸函数和凸集合：误解修复挑战”。一个函数的上镜图若是凸集合，那函数本身必然是凸函数。但反过来呢？看起来像碗的形状，就一定代表凸性吗？我们来做一个有趣的挑战，专门修复这个常见的误解。

actions.content: 点击这里开始我们的分类挑战

actions.text: 眼前的界面里，有十个不同的图形，有些是函数，有些是集合。你需要把它们拖入右边对应的桶里——凸的，或者非凸的。特别是要留心那个看起来像碗、但底部有波动的家伙。

actions.content: 请看这个形状——波动碗底，它正是我们常犯错的典型

actions.text: 看到没？它整体像碗，但底部局部有小坑。按照我们刚学的定义，任意两点连线都应该在函数上方。你拿两端的点一连线，就会发现连线穿过了函数内部，这可是非凸的铁证。现在，试试把它拖进你认为正确的桶里。

actions.content: 如果你放错桶，图形会震动提示，别担心，这正是学习发生的时刻

actions.text: 再注意看那个绝对值函数和星形集合。一个有尖点，一个像星星。直觉上尖点和凹角好像有问题，但今晚的关键悬念就是：为什么绝对值是凸的，而星形不是？靠你敏锐的几何直觉，把它们分清楚。

  <style>

      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      font-size: 16px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }

      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;

    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;

      max-width: 320px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

      z-index: 10;
    }
    #info h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    #info .formula {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #93c5fd;
      margin: 6px 0;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      background: rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.1);
      border-radius: 4px;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    #info p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #aaa;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    #info .key-point {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #34d399;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 25, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 14px 16px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 110px;
    }

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});

  <script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"data:text/javascript;base64,","three/addons/":"https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/","three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js":"data:text/javascript;base64,"}}</script>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    function checkWebGL() {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
          (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')));
      } catch(e) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    async function initScene() {
      try {
        if (!checkWebGL()) {
          throw new Error('浏览器不支持 WebGL');
        }

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('容器尺寸为零');

        // Scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0a0a1a, 0.015);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width / height, 0.1, 200);
        camera.position.set(6, 5, 8);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
        controls.target.set(0, 1.5, 0);
        controls.minDistance = 3;
        controls.maxDistance = 30;

        // === LIGHTING ===
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x88aaff, 0x444466, 0.6);
        scene.add(hemiLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight.position.set(8, 12, 6);
        dirLight.castShadow = true;
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8888ff, 0.4);
        fillLight.position.set(-6, 4, -4);
        scene.add(fillLight);

        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xfbbf24, 0.5, 20);
        pointLight.position.set(0, 3, 0);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        // Objects storage
        const objects = {};

        // === GRID / AXES ===
        const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(12, 24, 0x222244, 0x1a1a3a);
        gridHelper.position.y = 0;
        scene.add(gridHelper);
        objects.grid = gridHelper;

        // Axes
        const axisLen = 6;
        const xAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
          new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), axisLen, 0xff4444, 0.3, 0.15
        );
        scene.add(xAxis);

        const yAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), axisLen, 0x44ff44, 0.3, 0.15
        );
        scene.add(yAxis);

        const zAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), axisLen, 0x4488ff, 0.3, 0.15
        );
        scene.add(zAxis);

        // Axis labels using sprites
        function createTextSprite(text, position, color = '#ffffff') {
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 128;
          canvas.height = 64;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = color;
          ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText(text, 64, 32);
          const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
          const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true, depthTest: false });
          const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
          sprite.position.copy(position);
          sprite.scale.set(0.8, 0.4, 1);
          return sprite;
        }

        scene.add(createTextSprite('x', new THREE.Vector3(6.5, 0, 0), '#ff6666'));
        scene.add(createTextSprite('y', new THREE.Vector3(0, 6.5, 0), '#66ff66'));
        scene.add(createTextSprite('z', new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 6.5), '#6688ff'));
        scene.add(createTextSprite('f(x,y)=x²+y²', new THREE.Vector3(0, 5.5, 0), '#fbbf24'));

        // === PARABOLOID SURFACE f(x,y) = x² + y² ===
        const maxR = 2.5;
        const segR = 64;
        const segH = 32;

        // Build custom geometry for paraboloid
        function createParaboloidGeometry(maxR, segR, segH) {
          const positions = [];
          const normals = [];
          const uvs = [];
          const indices = [];

          for (let i = 0; i <= segH; i++) {
            const t = i / segH;
            const r = t * maxR;
            const z = r * r; // z = x² + y²

            for (let j = 0; j <= segR; j++) {
              const theta = (j / segR) * Math.PI * 2;
              const x = r * Math.cos(theta);
              const y = r * Math.sin(theta);
              positions.push(x, z, y);

              // Normal: gradient of f(x,y,z) = x² + y² - z = 0
              // grad = (2x, 2y, -1)
              const nx = 2 * x;
              const ny = -1;
              const nz = 2 * y;
              const len = Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz);
              normals.push(nx / len, ny / len, nz / len);

              uvs.push(j / segR, t);
            }
          }

          for (let i = 0; i < segH; i++) {
            for (let j = 0; j < segR; j++) {
              const a = i * (segR + 1) + j;
              const b = a + 1;
              const c = (i + 1) * (segR + 1) + j;
              const d = c + 1;
              indices.push(a, b, c);
              indices.push(b, d, c);
            }
          }

          const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
          geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
          geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
          geo.setIndex(indices);
          return geo;
        }

        const paraboloidGeo = createParaboloidGeometry(maxR, segR, segH);

        const paraboloidMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
          color: 0x6366f1,
          emissive: 0x1a1a4a,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.35,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          shininess: 60,
          specular: 0x4444aa
        });

        const paraboloid = new THREE.Mesh(paraboloidGeo, paraboloidMat);
        paraboloid.castShadow = true;
        paraboloid.receiveShadow = true;
        scene.add(paraboloid);
        objects.surface = paraboloid;

        // Wireframe overlay
        const wireMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0x818cf8,
          wireframe: true,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.15
        });
        const wireframe = new THREE.Mesh(paraboloidGeo, wireMat);
        scene.add(wireframe);
        objects.wireframe = wireframe;

        // === EPIGRAPH FILL (volume above paraboloid) ===
        function createEpigraphGeometry(maxR, segR, segH, maxHeight) {
          const positions = [];
          const normals = [];
          const uvs = [];
          const indices = [];

          // Bottom: paraboloid surface (inverted normal for volume)
          let vertOffset = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i <= segH; i++) {
            const t = i / segH;
            const r = t * maxR;
            const z = r * r;

            for (let j = 0; j <= segR; j++) {
              const theta = (j / segR) * Math.PI * 2;
              const x = r * Math.cos(theta);
              const y = r * Math.sin(theta);
              positions.push(x, z, y);
              // Inverted normal (pointing downward into volume)
              const nx = 2 * x;
              const ny = -1;
              const nz = 2 * y;
              const len = Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz);
              normals.push(-nx / len, -ny / len, -nz / len);
              uvs.push(j / segR, t);
            }
          }

          for (let i = 0; i < segH; i++) {
            for (let j = 0; j < segR; j++) {
              const a = vertOffset + i * (segR + 1) + j;
              const b = a + 1;
              const c = vertOffset + (i + 1) * (segR + 1) + j;
              const d = c + 1;
              indices.push(a, c, b);
              indices.push(b, c, d);
            }
          }

          // Top: flat disk at maxHeight
          const topCenterIdx = positions.length / 3;
          positions.push(0, maxHeight, 0);
          normals.push(0, 1, 0);
          uvs.push(0.5, 0.5);

          for (let j = 0; j <= segR; j++) {
            const theta = (j / segR) * Math.PI * 2;
            const x = maxR * Math.cos(theta);
            const y = maxR * Math.sin(theta);
            positions.push(x, maxHeight, y);
            normals.push(0, 1, 0);
            uvs.push(Math.cos(theta) * 0.5 + 0.5, Math.sin(theta) * 0.5 + 0.5);
          }

          const topStart = topCenterIdx + 1;
          for (let j = 0; j < segR; j++) {
            indices.push(topCenterIdx, topStart + j + 1, topStart + j);
          }

          // Side wall (cylinder from paraboloid edge to maxHeight)
          const sideStart = positions.length / 3;
          for (let j = 0; j <= segR; j++) {
            const theta = (j / segR) * Math.PI * 2;
            const x = maxR * Math.cos(theta);
            const y = maxR * Math.sin(theta);
            // Bottom point
            positions.push(x, maxR * maxR, y);
            normals.push(Math.cos(theta), 0, Math.sin(theta));
            uvs.push(j / segR, 0);
            // Top point
            positions.push(x, maxHeight, y);
            normals.push(Math.cos(theta), 0, Math.sin(theta));
            uvs.push(j / segR, 1);
          }

          for (let j = 0; j < segR; j++) {
            const a = sideStart + j * 2;
            const b = a + 1;
            const c = a + 2;
            const d = a + 3;
            indices.push(a, b, c);
            indices.push(b, d, c);
          }

          const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
          geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
          geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
          geo.setIndex(indices);
          geo.computeVertexNormals();
          return geo;
        }

        const maxHeight = maxR * maxR;
        const epigraphGeo = createEpigraphGeometry(maxR, 48, 24, maxHeight);

        const epigraphMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
          color: 0x10b981,
          emissive: 0x042f2e,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.12,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          depthWrite: false
        });

        const epigraph = new THREE.Mesh(epigraphGeo, epigraphMat);
        scene.add(epigraph);
        objects.epigraph = epigraph;

        // === CUTTING PLANE ===
        const cuttingPlaneGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(cuttingPlaneGroup);
        objects.cuttingPlane = cuttingPlaneGroup;

        // The cutting plane itself
        const planeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8, 8);
        const planeMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
          color: 0xf59e0b,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.15,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          depthWrite: false
        });
        const cuttingPlane = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, planeMat);
        cuttingPlane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        cuttingPlaneGroup.add(cuttingPlane);
        objects.cuttingPlaneMesh = cuttingPlane;

        // Intersection circle
        const circleGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.99, 1.01, 64);
        const circleMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0xf59e0b,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.9,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide
        });
        const circleMesh = new THREE.Mesh(circleGeo, circleMat);
        circleMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        cuttingPlaneGroup.add(circleMesh);
        objects.intersectionCircle = circleMesh;

        // Filled disk showing the cross-section
        const diskGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 64);
        const diskMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
          color: 0xf59e0b,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.4,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          emissive: 0x78350f,
          emissiveIntensity: 0.3
        });
        const diskMesh = new THREE.Mesh(diskGeo, diskMat);
        diskMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        cuttingPlaneGroup.add(diskMesh);
        objects.disk = diskMesh;

        // Radius annotation line
        const radiusLineGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const radiusLinePositions = new Float32Array(6);
        radiusLineGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(radiusLinePositions, 3));
        const radiusLineMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, linewidth: 2 });
        const radiusLine = new THREE.Line(radiusLineGeo, radiusLineMat);
        cuttingPlaneGroup.add(radiusLine);
        objects.radiusLine = radiusLine;

        // Update cutting plane
        function updateCuttingPlane(h) {

          const r = Math.sqrt(h);

          // Update circle
          circleMesh.scale.set(r, r, 1);
          circleMesh.position.y = 0;

          // Update disk
          diskMesh.scale.set(r, r, 1);
          diskMesh.position.y = 0;

          // Update radius line
          const positions = radiusLine.geometry.attributes.position.array;
          positions[0] = 0; positions[1] = 0; positions[2] = 0;
          positions[3] = r; positions[4] = 0; positions[5] = 0;
          radiusLine.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;

          // Update status bar
          const statusBar = document.getElementById('status-bar');
          statusBar.textContent = `截面半径 r = √${h.toFixed(2)} = ${r.toFixed(2)} — 凸集 ✓`;

        function updateHeightLabel(h) {
          while (heightLabelGroup.children.length > 0) {
            heightLabelGroup.remove(heightLabelGroup.children[0]);
          }

          // Vertical dashed line from origin to plane
          const lineGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          const linePos = new Float32Array([0, 0, 0, 0, h, 0]);
          lineGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(linePos, 3));
          const lineMat = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({
            color: 0xf59e0b,
            dashSize: 0.1,
            gapSize: 0.08,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.5
          });
          const line = new THREE.Line(lineGeo, lineMat);
          line.computeLineDistances();
          heightLabelGroup.add(line);

          // Label
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 256;
          canvas.height = 64;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
          ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText(`h = ${h.toFixed(2)}`, 128, 32);
          const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
          const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthTest: false });
          const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
          sprite.position.set(0.6, h, 0);
          sprite.scale.set(1.2, 0.3, 1);
          heightLabelGroup.add(sprite);
        }
        updateHeightLabel(currentHeight);

        // === STATE ===
        let epigraphVisible = true;
        let surfaceVisible = true;
        let animationSpeed = 1;

        // === ANIMATION ===
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          controls.update();

          // Subtle pulse on intersection circle
          const pulse = 1 + 0.03 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003);
          circleMesh.scale.set(
            Math.sqrt(currentHeight) * pulse,
            Math.sqrt(currentHeight) * pulse,
            1
          );

          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // === ZOOM CONTROLS ===
        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, 2.5);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, -2.5);
        });

        // === SLIDERS ===
        document.getElementById('height-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          currentHeight = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          updateCuttingPlane(currentHeight);
          updateHeightLabel(currentHeight);
        });

        document.getElementById('opacity-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          const opacity = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          paraboloidMat.opacity = opacity;
          wireMat.opacity = opacity * 0.5;
        });

        // === TOGGLE BUTTONS ===
        document.getElementById('toggle-epi').addEventListener('click', () => {
          epigraphVisible = !epigraphVisible;
          epigraph.visible = epigraphVisible;
          document.getElementById('toggle-epi').textContent = epigraphVisible ? '隐藏填充' : '显示填充';
        });

        document.getElementById('toggle-surface').addEventListener('click', () => {
          surfaceVisible = !surfaceVisible;
          paraboloid.visible = surfaceVisible;
          wireframe.visible = surfaceVisible;
          document.getElementById('toggle-surface').textContent = surfaceVisible ? '隐藏曲面' : '显示曲面';
        });

        // === RESET ===
        document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(6, 5, 8);
          controls.target.set(0, 1.5, 0);
          currentHeight = 1.5;
          document.getElementById('height-slider').value = 1.5;
          document.getElementById('opacity-slider').value = 0.3;
          paraboloidMat.opacity = 0.35;
          wireMat.opacity = 0.15;
          updateCuttingPlane(currentHeight);
          updateHeightLabel(currentHeight);

          epigraphVisible = true;
          epigraph.visible = true;
          document.getElementById('toggle-epi').textContent = '隐藏填充';

          surfaceVisible = true;
          paraboloid.visible = true;
          wireframe.visible = true;
          document.getElementById('toggle-surface').textContent = '隐藏曲面';
        });

        // === RESIZE ===
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const newWidth = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const newHeight = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = newWidth / newHeight;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(newWidth, newHeight);
        });

        // === TEACHER ACTIONS LISTENER ===
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          if (!event.data || !event.data.action) return;

          const { action, payload } = event.data;

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(...payload.cameraPosition);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(...payload.cameraTarget);
              }
              if (payload.planeHeight !== undefined) {
                currentHeight = payload.planeHeight;
                document.getElementById('height-slider').value = currentHeight;
                updateCuttingPlane(currentHeight);
                updateHeightLabel(currentHeight);
              }
              if (payload.opacity !== undefined) {
                paraboloidMat.opacity = payload.opacity;
                wireMat.opacity = payload.opacity * 0.5;
                document.getElementById('opacity-slider').value = payload.opacity;
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              const target = objects[elementId];
              if (!target) return;

              if (elementId === 'surface' && target) {
                paraboloidMat.emissive.set(highlight ? 0x4444aa : 0x1a1a4a);
                paraboloidMat.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.8 : 0.1;
              } else if (elementId === 'epigraph' && target) {
                epigraphMat.emissive.set(highlight ? 0x047857 : 0x042f2e);
                epigraphMat.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.5 : 0.1;
                epigraphMat.opacity = highlight ? 0.25 : 0.12;
              } else if (elementId === 'intersectionCircle' && target) {
                circleMat.color.set(highlight ? 0xffdd00 : 0xf59e0b);
                diskMat.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 0.6 : 0.3;
              } else if (elementId === 'cuttingPlane' && target) {
                planeMat.opacity = highlight ? 0.3 : 0.15;
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              const target = objects[elementId];
              if (!target || !text) return;

              // Remove existing annotation for this element
              if (objects['annotation_' + elementId]) {
                scene.remove(objects['annotation_' + elementId]);
              }

              const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
              canvas.width = 512;
              canvas.height = 128;
              const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 15, 30, 0.85)';
              ctx.roundRect(0, 0, 512, 128, 16);
              ctx.fill();
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#6366f1';
              ctx.lineWidth = 2;
              ctx.roundRect(0, 0, 512, 128, 16);
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
              ctx.font = '24px "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif';
              ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
              ctx.fillText(text, 256, 64);

              const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
              const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthTest: false });
              const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);

              if (elementId === 'surface') {
                sprite.position.set(0, maxHeight + 1, 0);
                sprite.scale.set(4, 1, 1);
              } else if (elementId === 'epigraph') {
                sprite.position.set(2, maxHeight / 2, 0);
                sprite.scale.set(3, 0.75, 1);
              } else if (elementId === 'intersectionCircle') {
                sprite.position.set(0, currentHeight + 0.8, 0);
                sprite.scale.set(3, 0.75, 1);
              } else {
                const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(target);
                const center = new THREE.Vector3();
                box.getCenter(center);
                sprite.position.copy(center);
                sprite.position.y += 1;
                sprite.scale.set(3, 0.75, 1);
              }

              scene.add(sprite);
              objects['annotation_' + elementId] = sprite;
              break;
            }
          }
        });

        // Hide loading
        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Scene initialization failed:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML =
          `<div style="text-align:center;color:#ff6b6b;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px;">⚠️</div>
            3D 场景加载失败<br>
            <small style="color:#888;">${error.message}</small><br>
            <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:8px 16px;background:#6366f1;color:white;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">重试</button>
          </div>`;
      }
    }

    initScene();
  </script>

elements.content: 标准型与对偶性 —— 理解为什么有时解决对偶问题更快。对偶问题往往有更少的约束或更简单的结构。

QP：二次目标
线性约束

actions.text: 本场景聚焦“线性/二次规划入口”。既然大家已经明白了什么是凸函数和凸集合，本场景中，我们就要进入优化理论中，最简单但也最强大的板块——线性规划与二次规划。
它们是整个优化世界的入口。虽然结构简单，但在工程、金融和资源调度中有极其广泛的应用，是我们解决复杂问题的基石。
首先看线性规划，简称 LP。它的核心特征是：所有目标函数和约束条件都是线性的。也就是说，在几何上，我们是在一个由直线或平面围成的可行区域内，寻找一个线性函数的最优解。
看这个标准形式，我们最小化一个线性向量 c 与 x 的内积。大家应该还记得，我们刚才在拉格朗日乘子法中，处理的主要就是这类等式约束。
接下来是二次规划，简称 QP。与 LP 不同，它的目标函数是弯的，通常表现为一个开口向上的抛物面，达成凸性。但好消息是，它的约束依然是线性的，是‘直’的。
看这个 QP 公式，目标函数里多了一个 x 转置乘以 H 矩阵再乘以 x 的二次项。这个 H 矩阵极其关键，我们一会儿会看到，如果它是正定的，问题就是一个漂亮的‘碗状’函数，保证了全局最优解。
最后，我们要引出标准型与对偶性的概念。为什么有时解决原问题很慢，但绕道解它的对偶问题却快得多？对偶理论能帮我们理解，同一个优化问题竟然可以从两个完全不同的视角去描述，而且它们的最优解是等价的。

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
