<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');

// State
let state = {
  running: false,
  ended: false,
  paused: false,
  problemType: 'LP', // 'LP' or 'QP'
  c1: 1.0,
  c2: 1.0,
  q11: 0.0,
  q22: 0.0,
  q12: 0.0,
  // Search path animation
  searchPoint: { x: 5, y: 5 },
  optimalPoint: null,
  pathHistory: [],
  time: 0,
  contourOffset: 0,
  stepProgress: 0
};

// Feasible region: define by constraints Ax <= b
// Vertices computed from intersection of:
// x >= 0, y >= 0, x + y <= 10, 2x + y <= 14, x + 2y <= 12
const constraints = [
  { a: -1, b: 0, c: 0 },     // x >= 0  -> -x <= 0
  { a: 0, b: -1, c: 0 },     // y >= 0  -> -y <= 0
  { a: 1, b: 1, c: 10 },     // x + y <= 10
  { a: 2, b: 1, c: 14 },     // 2x + y <= 14
  { a: 1, b: 2, c: 12 },     // x + 2y <= 12
];

// Precompute vertices of feasible region
function computeVertices() {
  const verts = [];
  const pairs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < constraints.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < constraints.length; j++) {
      pairs.push([i, j]);
    }
  }
  for (const [i, j] of pairs) {
    const a1 = constraints[i], a2 = constraints[j];
    const det = a1.a * a2.b - a2.a * a1.b;
    if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-10) continue;
    const x = (a1.c * a2.b - a2.c * a1.b) / det;
    const y = (a1.a * a2.c - a2.a * a1.c) / det;
    // Check if this point satisfies all constraints
    let feasible = true;
    for (const con of constraints) {
      if (con.a * x + con.b * y > con.c + 1e-6) {
        feasible = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (feasible) {
      // Avoid duplicates
      let dup = false;
      for (const v of verts) {
        if (Math.abs(v.x - x) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(v.y - y) < 1e-6) {
          dup = true; break;
        }
      }
      if (!dup) verts.push({ x, y });
    }
  }
  // Sort vertices by angle around centroid
  if (verts.length === 0) return [];
  const cx = verts.reduce((s, v) => s + v.x, 0) / verts.length;
  const cy = verts.reduce((s, v) => s + v.y, 0) / verts.length;
  verts.sort((a, b) => Math.atan2(a.y - cy, a.x - cx) - Math.atan2(b.y - cy, b.x - cx));
  return verts;
}

const feasibleVertices = computeVertices();

// Coordinate mapping
let viewXMin = -2, viewXMax = 16, viewYMin = -2, viewYMax = 16;
let canvasW, canvasH;

function worldToCanvas(wx, wy) {
  const px = ((wx - viewXMin) / (viewXMax - viewXMin)) * canvasW;
  const py = ((viewYMax - wy) / (viewYMax - viewYMin)) * canvasH;
  return [px, py];
}

function canvasToWorld(px, py) {
  const wx = viewXMin + (px / canvasW) * (viewXMax - viewXMin);
  const wy = viewYMax - (py / canvasH) * (viewYMax - viewYMin);
  return [wx, wy];
}

function resizeCanvas() {
  const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  canvasW = rect.width;
  canvasH = rect.height;
  canvas.width = canvasW * dpr;
  canvas.height = canvasH * dpr;
  canvas.style.width = canvasW + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = canvasH + 'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  if (!state.running) draw();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(resizeCanvas);
resizeObserver.observe(container);

// Objective function
function objective(x, y) {
  const q11 = state.q11, q22 = state.q22, q12 = state.q12;
  const c1 = state.c1, c2 = state.c2;
  return 0.5 * (q11 * x * x + q22 * y * y + 2 * q12 * x * y) + c1 * x + c2 * y;
}

function gradient(x, y) {
  return {
    gx: state.q11 * x + state.q12 * y + state.c1,
    gy: state.q12 * x + state.q22 * y + state.c2
  };
}

// Check if point is feasible
function isFeasible(x, y) {
  for (const con of constraints) {
    if (con.a * x + con.b * y > con.c + 1e-6) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// Project point onto feasible region (simple projection by finding closest feasible point)
function projectToFeasible(x, y) {
  if (isFeasible(x, y)) return { x, y };
  // Try each vertex and edge midpoint
  let best = null, bestDist = Infinity;
  for (const v of feasibleVertices) {
    const d = (v.x - x) ** 2 + (v.y - y) ** 2;
    if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = v; }
  }
  // Also check edge projections
  for (let i = 0; i < feasibleVertices.length; i++) {
    const v1 = feasibleVertices[i];
    const v2 = feasibleVertices[(i + 1) % feasibleVertices.length];
    const dx = v2.x - v1.x, dy = v2.y - v1.y;
    const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (len2 < 1e-10) continue;
    let t = ((x - v1.x) * dx + (y - v1.y) * dy) / len2;
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
    const px = v1.x + t * dx, py = v1.y + t * dy;
    if (isFeasible(px, py)) {
      const d = (px - x) ** 2 + (py - y) ** 2;
      if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = { x: px, y: py }; }
    }
  }
  return best || { x: 0, y: 0 };
}

// Find optimal solution
function findOptimal() {
  const q11 = state.q11, q22 = state.q22, q12 = state.q12;
  const det = q11 * q22 - q12 * q12;
  let unconstrained;

  if (det > 1e-8) {
    // QP: find unconstrained minimum
    const ux = (q12 * state.c2 - q22 * state.c1) / det;
    const uy = (q12 * state.c1 - q11 * state.c2) / det;
    unconstrained = { x: ux, y: uy };
  } else {
    // LP or singular Q: no unconstrained minimum, optimal at vertex
    unconstrained = null;
  }

  if (unconstrained && isFeasible(unconstrained.x, unconstrained.y)) {
    return unconstrained;
  }

  // Check vertices
  let bestPt = null, bestVal = Infinity;
  for (const v of feasibleVertices) {
    const val = objective(v.x, v.y);
    if (val < bestVal) { bestVal = val; bestPt = v; }
  }

  // For QP, also check edge projections of unconstrained point
  if (unconstrained) {
    for (let i = 0; i < feasibleVertices.length; i++) {
      const v1 = feasibleVertices[i];
      const v2 = feasibleVertices[(i + 1) % feasibleVertices.length];
      const dx = v2.x - v1.x, dy = v2.y - v1.y;
      const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (len2 < 1e-10) continue;
      let t = ((unconstrained.x - v1.x) * dx + (unconstrained.y - v1.y) * dy) / len2;
      t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
      const px = v1.x + t * dx, py = v1.y + t * dy;
      if (isFeasible(px, py)) {
        const val = objective(px, py);
        if (val < bestVal) { bestVal = val; bestPt = { x: px, y: py }; }
      }
    }
  }

  return bestPt || { x: 0, y: 0 };
}

// Search path: gradient descent with projection
function computeSearchPath() {
  const steps = 30;
  const path = [];
  // Start from a corner
  let px = 5.0, py = 5.0;
  if (isFeasible(px, py)) {
    path.push({ x: px, y: py });
  } else {
    // Find a feasible starting point
    for (const v of feasibleVertices) {
      px = v.x; py = v.y;
      path.push({ x: px, y: py });
      break;
    }
  }

  const lr = 0.15;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const g = gradient(px, py);
    let nx = px - lr * g.gx;
    let ny = py - lr * g.gy;
    const proj = projectToFeasible(nx, ny);
    px = proj.x; py = proj.y;
    path.push({ x: px, y: py });
  }
  return path;
}

// Drawing functions
function drawGrid() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.15)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (let x = Math.ceil(viewXMin); x <= viewXMax; x++) {
    const [px] = worldToCanvas(x, 0);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(px, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(px, canvasH);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = Math.ceil(viewYMin); y <= viewYMax; y++) {
    const [, py] = worldToCanvas(0, y);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, py);
    ctx.lineTo(canvasW, py);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawAxes() {
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  // X axis
  const [, y0] = worldToCanvas(0, 0);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, y0);
  ctx.lineTo(canvasW, y0);
  ctx.stroke();
  // Y axis
  const [x0] = worldToCanvas(0, 0);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(x0, canvasH);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Axis labels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.font = '11px sans-serif';
  for (let x = 0; x <= 15; x += 2) {
    const [px] = worldToCanvas(x, 0);
    ctx.fillText(x, px - 3, y0 + 14);
  }
  for (let y = 0; y <= 15; y += 2) {
    const [, py] = worldToCanvas(0, y);
    ctx.fillText(y, x0 - 16, py + 4);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.font = 'bold 12px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('x', canvasW - 15, y0 - 8);
  ctx.fillText('y', x0 + 8, 14);
}

function drawFeasibleRegion() {
  if (feasibleVertices.length < 3) return;

  // Fill
  ctx.beginPath();
  const [sx, sy] = worldToCanvas(feasibleVertices[0].x, feasibleVertices[0].y);
  ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
  for (let i = 1; i < feasibleVertices.length; i++) {
    const [px, py] = worldToCanvas(feasibleVertices[i].x, feasibleVertices[i].y);
    ctx.lineTo(px, py);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.6)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Draw constraint lines
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (const con of constraints) {
    if (con.a === 0) {
      const [, py] = worldToCanvas(0, con.c);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, py); ctx.lineTo(canvasW, py); ctx.stroke();
    } else if (con.b === 0) {
      const [px] = worldToCanvas(con.c, 0);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, 0); ctx.lineTo(px, canvasH); ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      const y1 = Math.max(viewYMin, (con.c - con.a * viewXMin) / con.b);
      const y2 = Math.max(viewYMin, (con.c - con.a * viewXMax) / con.b);
      const [x1, py1] = worldToCanvas(viewXMin, y1);
      const [x2, py2] = worldToCanvas(viewXMax, y2);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, py1); ctx.lineTo(x2, py2); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Vertices
  for (const v of feasibleVertices) {
    const [px, py] = worldToCanvas(v.x, v.y);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#166534';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#86efac';
    ctx.font = '10px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(`(${v.x.toFixed(1)},${v.y.toFixed(1)})`, px + 6, py - 6);
  }
}

function drawContours() {
  const q11 = state.q11, q22 = state.q22, q12 = state.q12;
  const c1 = state.c1, c2 = state.c2;
  const isQP = (q11 > 0.01 || q22 > 0.01);

  const optimal = state.optimalPoint;
  if (!optimal) return;

  const optVal = objective(optimal.x, optimal.y);
  const contourStep = 0.5;
  const numContours = 8;

  for (let i = 1; i <= numContours; i++) {
    const targetVal = optVal + i * contourStep;
    const alpha = 0.15 + 0.1 * (i / numContours);

    if (isQP) {
      drawEllipseContour(targetVal, alpha, i === numContours);
    } else {
      drawLinearContour(targetVal, alpha, i === numContours);
    }
  }
}

function drawLinearContour(targetVal, alpha, highlight) {
  const c1 = state.c1, c2 = state.c2;
  if (Math.abs(c1) < 1e-8 && Math.abs(c2) < 1e-8) return;

  // c1*x + c2*y = targetVal
  let x1, y1, x2, y2;
  if (Math.abs(c2) > 1e-8) {
    x1 = viewXMin; y1 = (targetVal - c1 * x1) / c2;
    x2 = viewXMax; y2 = (targetVal - c1 * x2) / c2;
  } else {
    y1 = viewYMin; x1 = (targetVal - c2 * y1) / c1;
    y2 = viewYMax; x2 = (targetVal - c2 * y2) / c1;
  }

  const [px1, py1] = worldToCanvas(x1, y1);
  const [px2, py2] = worldToCanvas(x2, y2);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(px1, py1);
  ctx.lineTo(px2, py2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = highlight ? `rgba(129, 140, 248, ${alpha + 0.3})` : `rgba(129, 140, 248, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = highlight ? 2 : 1;
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawEllipseContour(targetVal, alpha, highlight) {
  const q11 = state.q11, q22 = state.q22, q12 = state.q12;
  const c1 = state.c1, c2 = state.c2;
  const det = q11 * q22 - q12 * q12;

  if (det < 1e-8) {
    drawLinearContour(targetVal, alpha, highlight);
    return;
  }

  // Unconstrained center
  const cx = (q12 * c2 - q22 * c1) / det;
  const cy = (q12 * c1 - q11 * c2) / det;
  const centerVal = objective(cx, cy);
  const r2 = 2 * (targetVal - centerVal) / (q11 + q22);

  if (r2 < 0) return;

  const rx = Math.sqrt(r2 / q11) * (q11 > 0.01 ? 1 : 5);
  const ry = Math.sqrt(r2 / q22) * (q22 > 0.01 ? 1 : 5);

  // For cross term, rotate the ellipse
  let angle = 0;
  if (q12 !== 0) {
    angle = 0.5 * Math.atan2(2 * q12, q11 - q22);
  }

  const [px, py] = worldToCanvas(cx, cy);
  const [crx] = worldToCanvas(cx + rx, cy);
  const [, cry] = worldToCanvas(cx, cy + ry);
  const scale = Math.abs(crx - px) / rx;
  const scale2 = Math.abs(cry - py) / ry;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(px, py);
  ctx.rotate(angle);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, rx * scale, ry * scale2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = highlight ? `rgba(129, 140, 248, ${alpha + 0.3})` : `rgba(129, 140, 248, ${alpha})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = highlight ? 2 : 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSearchPath() {
  if (state.pathHistory.length < 2) return;

  // Draw path
  ctx.beginPath();
  const [sx, sy] = worldToCanvas(state.pathHistory[0].x, state.pathHistory[0].y);
  ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
  for (let i = 1; i <= state.stepProgress && i < state.pathHistory.length; i++) {
    const [px, py] = worldToCanvas(state.pathHistory[i].x, state.pathHistory[i].y);
    ctx.lineTo(px, py);
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Draw path points
  for (let i = 0; i <= state.stepProgress && i < state.pathHistory.length; i++) {
    const [px, py] = worldToCanvas(state.pathHistory[i].x, state.pathHistory[i].y);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawOptimalPoint() {
  if (!state.optimalPoint) return;
  const { x, y } = state.optimalPoint;
  const [px, py] = worldToCanvas(x, y);

  // Glow effect
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, 20);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Point
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(px, py, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Star
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('★', px, py);
  ctx.textAlign = 'start';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';

  // Label
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(`最优 (${x.toFixed(2)}, ${y.toFixed(2)})`, px + 14, py - 4);
  const val = objective(x, y);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.font = '10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(`f* = ${val.toFixed(3)}`, px + 14, py + 10);

  // Show if interior or vertex
  let isVertex = false;
  for (const v of feasibleVertices) {
    if (Math.abs(v.x - x) < 0.01 && Math.abs(v.y - y) < 0.01) {
      isVertex = true; break;
    }
  }
  let isInInterior = isFeasible(x + 0.1, y + 0.1) && isFeasible(x - 0.1, y + 0.1) &&
                      isFeasible(x + 0.1, y - 0.1) && isFeasible(x - 0.1, y - 0.1);

  const label = isVertex ? '📍 顶点 Vertex' : (isInInterior ? '🔵 内部 Interior' : '🔶 边界 Boundary');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(label, px + 14, py + 24);
}

function drawGradientArrow() {
  if (!state.optimalPoint) return;
  const { x, y } = state.optimalPoint;
  const g = gradient(x, y);
  const mag = Math.sqrt(g.gx * g.gx + g.gy * g.gy);
  if (mag < 0.01) return;

  // For QP at optimum, gradient should be ~0 (if interior)
  // Show gradient direction at a nearby feasible point
  const gNorm = Math.min(mag, 5);
  const arrowLen = gNorm * 1.5;
  const dx = -(g.gx / mag) * arrowLen;
  const dy = -(g.gy / mag) * arrowLen;

  const [sx, sy] = worldToCanvas(x, y);
  const [ex, ey] = worldToCanvas(x + dx, y + dy);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
  ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Arrowhead
  const angle = Math.atan2(ey - sy, ex - sx);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(ex, ey);
  ctx.lineTo(ex - 8 * Math.cos(angle - 0.4), ey - 8 * Math.sin(angle - 0.4));
  ctx.moveTo(ex, ey);
  ctx.lineTo(ex - 8 * Math.cos(angle + 0.4), ey - 8 * Math.sin(angle + 0.4));
  ctx.stroke();
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);

  // Background gradient
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvasH);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0e1a');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0f172a');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);

  drawGrid();
  drawAxes();
  drawFeasibleRegion();
  drawContours();
  drawSearchPath();
  drawOptimalPoint();

  // Type label on canvas
  ctx.fillStyle = state.problemType === 'LP' ? '#22c55e' : '#a78bfa';
  ctx.font = 'bold 16px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(
    state.problemType === 'LP' ? '线性规划 LP' : '二次规划 QP',
    canvasW - 140, 28
  );
}

// Animation loop
let animId = null;
let lastTime = 0;

function animate(timestamp) {
  if (!state.running) return;
  if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
  const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
  lastTime = timestamp;

  state.time += dt;

  // Animate search path
  if (state.pathHistory.length > 0 && state.stepProgress < state.pathHistory.length) {
    const speed = 15; // steps per second
    state.stepProgress = Math.min(
      state.pathHistory.length - 1,
      state.stepProgress + speed * dt
    );

    if (state.stepProgress >= state.pathHistory.length - 1) {
      state.stepProgress = state.pathHistory.length - 1;
      onSimulationEnd();
    }
  }

  draw();
  updateHUD();
  animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

function updateHUD() {
  const statusDot = document.getElementById('status-dot');
  const statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');
  const hudInfo = document.getElementById('hud-info');
  const optimalInfo = document.getElementById('optimal-info');

  if (state.running && !state.ended) {
    statusDot.className = 'status-dot running';
    statusText.textContent = '搜索中 Searching...';
    hudInfo.innerHTML = `步数 Step: ${Math.floor(state.stepProgress)}/${state.pathHistory.length - 1}<br>时间 t: ${state.time.toFixed(1)}s`;
  } else if (state.ended) {
    statusDot.className = 'status-dot ended';
    statusText.textContent = '已完成 Done';
    hudInfo.innerHTML = `搜索完成<br>共 ${state.pathHistory.length - 1} 步`;
  } else {
    statusDot.className = 'status-dot idle';
    statusText.textContent = '就绪 Ready';
    hudInfo.innerHTML = '等待启动...';
  }

  if (state.optimalPoint) {
    const { x, y } = state.optimalPoint;
    const val = objective(x, y);
    optimalInfo.innerHTML = `x* = ${x.toFixed(3)}<br>y* = ${y.toFixed(3)}<br>f* = ${val.toFixed(4)}`;
  }
}

function onSimulationEnd() {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = true;
  state.paused = false;
  lastTime = 0;
  if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
  updateMainButton();
  updateHUD();
}

// Controls
function handleMainBtn() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
    setTimeout(() => startSimulation(), 100);
  } else if (state.running) {
    pauseSimulation();
  } else {
    startSimulation();
  }
}

function startSimulation() {
  state.running = true;
  state.ended = false;
  state.paused = false;
  lastTime = 0;
  updateMainButton();
  animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

function pauseSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.paused = true;
  lastTime = 0;
  if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
  updateMainButton();
}

function resetSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.paused = false;
  state.time = 0;
  state.stepProgress = 0;
  state.pathHistory = [];
  state.contourOffset = 0;
  lastTime = 0;
  if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);

  // Re-compute optimal and path
  state.optimalPoint = findOptimal();
  state.pathHistory = computeSearchPath();
  state.searchPoint = state.pathHistory[0];

  updateMainButton();
  updateModeIndicator();
  draw();
  updateHUD();
}

function updateMainButton() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('main-btn');
  if (state.ended) {
    btn.textContent = '🔄 重新开始';
  } else if (state.running) {
    btn.textContent = '⏸ 暂停';
  } else if (state.paused) {
    btn.textContent = '▶ 继续';
  } else {
    btn.textContent = '▶ 启动搜索';
  }
}

function toggleProblemType() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('toggle-type-btn');
  const formula = document.getElementById('formula-display');

  if (state.problemType === 'LP') {
    state.problemType = 'QP';
    btn.textContent = '切换到 LP · 线性规划';
    formula.innerHTML = 'min ½xᵀQx + cᵀx   s.t. Ax ≤ b, x ≥ 0';
    // Default QP values
    state.q11 = 2.0;
    state.q22 = 2.0;
    state.q12 = 0;
    document.getElementById('q11-slider').value = 2.0;
    document.getElementById('q22-slider').value = 2.0;
    document.getElementById('q12-slider').value = 0;
    updateSliderDisplays();
  } else {
    state.problemType = 'LP';
    btn.textContent = '切换到 QP · 二次规划';
    formula.innerHTML = 'min cᵀx   s.t. Ax ≤ b, x ≥ 0';
    state.q11 = 0;
    state.q22 = 0;
    state.q12 = 0;
    document.getElementById('q11-slider').value = 0;
    document.getElementById('q22-slider').value = 0;
    document.getElementById('q12-slider').value = 0;
    updateSliderDisplays();
  }

  resetSimulation();
}

function updateModeIndicator() {
  const badge = document.getElementById('mode-badge');
  const isQP = state.q11 > 0.01 || state.q22 > 0.01;
  if (isQP) {
    badge.className = 'mode-indicator qp';
    badge.textContent = 'QP · 二次规划';
  } else {
    badge.className = 'mode-indicator lp';
    badge.textContent = 'LP · 线性规划';
  }
}

function updateSliderDisplays() {
  document.getElementById('c1-display').textContent = parseFloat(state.c1).toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('c2-display').textContent = parseFloat(state.c2).toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('q11-display').textContent = parseFloat(state.q11).toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('q22-display').textContent = parseFloat(state.q22).toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('q12-display').textContent = parseFloat(state.q12).toFixed(1);
  updateModeIndicator();
}

function onSliderChange() {
  state.c1 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('c1-slider').value);
  state.c2 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('c2-slider').value);
  state.q11 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('q11-slider').value);
  state.q22 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('q22-slider').value);
  state.q12 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('q12-slider').value);
  updateSliderDisplays();
  resetSimulation();
}

// Slider event listeners
['c1', 'c2', 'q11', 'q22', 'q12'].forEach(name => {
  const slider = document.getElementById(name + '-slider');
  slider.addEventListener('input', onSliderChange);
});

// Presets
const presets = {
  lp_vertex: { c1: 1.0, c2: 1.0, q11: 0, q22: 0, q12: 0 },
  qp_interior: { c1: -1.5, c2: -1.5, q11: 2.0, q22: 2.0, q12: 0 },
  qp_boundary: { c1: -4.0, c2: -2.0, q11: 1.0, q22: 1.0, q12: 0 },
  lp_parallel: { c1: 2.0, c2: 0.5, q11: 0, q22: 0, q12: 0 },
};

function applyPreset(name) {
  const p = presets[name];
  if (!p) return;
  state.c1 = p.c1;
  state.c2 = p.c2;
  state.q11 = p.q11;
  state.q22 = p.q22;
  state.q12 = p.q12;

  document.getElementById('c1-slider').value = p.c1;
  document.getElementById('c2-slider').value = p.c2;
  document.getElementById('q11-slider').value = p.q11;
  document.getElementById('q22-slider').value = p.q22;
  document.getElementById('q12-slider').value = p.q12;

  // Update problem type indicator
  if (p.q11 > 0 || p.q22 > 0) {
    state.problemType = 'QP';
    document.getElementById('toggle-type-btn').textContent = '切换到 LP · 线性规划';
    document.getElementById('formula-display').innerHTML = 'min ½xᵀQx + cᵀx   s.t. Ax ≤ b, x ≥ 0';
  } else {
    state.problemType = 'LP';
    document.getElementById('toggle-type-btn').textContent = '切换到 QP · 二次规划';
    document.getElementById('formula-display').innerHTML = 'min cᵀx   s.t. Ax ≤ b, x ≥ 0';
  }

  updateSliderDisplays();
  resetSimulation();
}

// Keyboard shortcuts
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.code === 'Space') {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleMainBtn();
  } else if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
    resetSimulation();
  }
});

// postMessage listener
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  const { type, target, state: msgState, content } = event.data;

  switch (type) {
    case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE':
      if (msgState) {
        Object.entries(msgState).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          const slider = document.getElementById(key + '-slider');
          if (slider) {
            slider.value = value;
            slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          }
        });
      }
      break;

    case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT':
      const highlightEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (highlightEl) {
        highlightEl.style.outline = '3px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8)';
        highlightEl.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
        highlightEl.style.animation = 'pulse-highlight 2s infinite';
        setTimeout(() => {
          highlightEl.style.outline = '';
          highlightEl.style.animation = '';
        }, 3000);
      }
      break;

    case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT':
      const annotateEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (annotateEl && content) {
        const rect = annotateEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
        tooltip.className = 'teacher-annotation';
        tooltip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:' + (rect.top - 40) + 'px; left:' + rect.left + 'px; background:rgba(139,92,246,0.95); color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; z-index:1000; animation:fadeIn 0.3s;';
        tooltip.textContent = content;
        document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
        setTimeout(() => tooltip.remove(), 4000);
      }
      break;

    case 'REVEAL_ELEMENT':
      const revealEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (revealEl) {
        revealEl.style.display = '';
        revealEl.style.opacity = '1';
      }
      break;
  }
});

const style = document.createElement('style');
style.textContent = '@keyframes pulse-highlight { 0%, 100% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8); } 50% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); } } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }';
document.head.appendChild(style);

// Initialize
function init() {
  resizeCanvas();
  state.optimalPoint = findOptimal();
  state.pathHistory = computeSearchPath();
  updateSliderDisplays();
  updateModeIndicator();
  updateMainButton();
  draw();
  updateHUD();
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 线性规划(LP)与二次规划(QP)对比：观察等高线从直线变为椭圆，最优点从顶点移动到内部

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“线性/二次规划入口：拖动实验”。在刚才的线性规划讨论中，我们看到了最优解总是出现在可行域的顶点上。现在让我们通过实验来对比一个更一般的情形：当目标函数从线性的 ( c^T x ) 变成二次函数时，最优点会躲到哪里去呢？

actions.content: 先关注这两个二次项系数 ( Q_{11} ) 和 ( Q_{22} )。

actions.text: 当前预设是标准的 LP 模式，二次项系数 ( Q_{11} ) 和 ( Q_{22} ) 都是零。请观察下面的等高线：它们是一组平行的直线，梯度方向永远不变，所以最优解被‘推’到了约束多面体的顶点上。

actions.content: 切换到‘QP 内部最优’预设状态。

actions.text: 现在我把 ( Q_{11} ) 和 ( Q_{22} ) 增大到 2，等高线立刻从直线收缩成了一个个嵌套的椭圆。你会发现，椭圆的中心正好落在可行域的内部——这就是二次规划的最优解，它不再依赖顶点，而是由二次曲面的中心与约束边界共同决定。

actions.content: 切换到‘QP 边界最优’预设状态。

actions.text: 再看这一组参数。当一次项系数 ( c ) 非常大，把椭圆的中心推到了可行域外面时，二次规划的最优解就被‘卡’在了约束边界上，而不是在顶点。这正好展示了 LP 与 QP 在最优解位置上最本质的区别。

actions.content: 顶点最优、内部最优与边界最优三种典型情况示意。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>线性/二次规划入口：关系图</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #0d1117;
    color: #e6edf3;
    font-family: -apple-system, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
    display: flex;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  #sidebar {
    width: 340px;
    min-width: 340px;
    background: #161b22;
    border-right: 1px solid #30363d;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transition: margin-left 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease;
    z-index: 10;
  }
  #sidebar.collapsed {
    margin-left: -340px;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #sidebar-header {
    padding: 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #30363d;
    background: #1c2129;
  }
  #sidebar-header h2 {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #58a6ff;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  #sidebar-header p {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #8b949e;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #sidebar-content {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 20px;
  }
  #detail-box {
    background: #0d1117;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 18px;
    min-height: 120px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }
  #detail-box .detail-title {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #f0f6fc;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  #detail-box .detail-body {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #8b949e;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }
  #detail-box .detail-body strong {
    color: #c9d1d9;
  }
  #detail-box .detail-body .term {
    color: #58a6ff;
    background: rgba(88,166,255,0.1);
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  #detail-box .misconception {
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: rgba(248,81,73,0.08);
    border-left: 3px solid #f85149;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #f0883e;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #detail-box .misconception::before {
    content: "⚠️ 常见误解：";
    font-weight: 600;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    color: #f85149;
  }
  #detail-box .insight {
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: rgba(63,185,80,0.08);
    border-left: 3px solid #3fb950;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #7ee787;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #detail-box .insight::before {
    content: "💡 关键直觉：";
    font-weight: 600;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    color: #3fb950;
  }
  #placeholder {
    color: #484f58;
    font-size: 13px;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }
  #placeholder .hint-icon {
    font-size: 32px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: block;
  }
  #controls {
    padding: 16px 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid #30363d;
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    background: #21262d;
    color: #c9d1d9;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .btn:hover { background: #30363d; border-color: #8b949e; }
  .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; background: #161b22; }
  .btn-primary { background: #238636; border-color: #2ea043; color: #fff; }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #2ea043; }
  .btn-primary:disabled { background: #238636; opacity: 0.35; }

  #step-counter {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #484f58;
    border-top: 1px solid #21262d;
  }

  #diagram-area {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #toggle-sidebar {
    position: absolute;
    top: 14px;
    left: 14px;
    z-index: 20;
    background: #161b22;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    color: #c9d1d9;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 18px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }
  #toggle-sidebar:hover { background: #21262d; }

  #diagram-title {
    position: absolute;
    top: 14px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 5;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #484f58;
    font-weight: 500;
    pointer-events: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  #svg-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .node-group { cursor: pointer; }
  .node-group:hover .node-rect {
    filter: brightness(1.15);
    stroke: #58a6ff;
  }
  .node-group.revealed .node-rect {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .node-group:not(.revealed) .node-rect {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .node-group:not(.revealed) .node-icon,
  .node-group:not(.revealed) .node-label,
  .node-group:not(.revealed) .node-sublabel {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  .node-group.selected .node-rect {
    stroke: #58a6ff;
    stroke-width: 2.5;
    filter: brightness(1.2);
  }
  .node-rect {
    rx: 12; ry: 12;
    fill: #ffffff;
    stroke: #30363d;
    stroke-width: 1.5;
    transition: filter 0.15s ease, stroke 0.15s ease, opacity 0.4s ease;
  }
  .node-icon {
    font-size: 22px;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .node-label {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    fill: #0d1117;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  }
  .node-sublabel {
    font-size: 11px;
    fill: #656d76;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  }

  .edge-path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: #30363d;
    stroke-width: 2;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease, stroke 0.3s ease;
  }
  .edge-path.active {
    stroke: #3fb950;
    stroke-width: 2.5;
  }
  .edge-path:not(.active) { opacity: 0; }

  .edge-label-bg {
    fill: #0d1117;
    rx: 4; ry: 4;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  }
  .edge-label-text {
    font-size: 11px;
    fill: #8b949e;
    text-anchor: middle;
    dominant-baseline: middle;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .edge-label-group:not(.active) { opacity: 0; }

  .arrow-marker { fill: #3fb950; }

  @keyframes nodeAppear {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  }

  .reveal-anim {
    animation: nodeAppear 0.4s ease forwards;
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #sidebar {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; top: 0; height: 100%;
      width: 300px;
      min-width: 300px;
      box-shadow: 4px 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }
    #sidebar.collapsed {
      margin-left: -300px;
    }
    #diagram-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      top: 10px;
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  const NODE_WIDTH = 170, NODE_HEIGHT = 68, ARROW_OFFSET = 10;

  const container = document.getElementById('svg-container');
  const detailBox = document.getElementById('detail-box');
  const placeholder = document.getElementById('placeholder');
  const btnNext = document.getElementById('btn-next');
  const btnPrev = document.getElementById('btn-prev');
  const stepCounter = document.getElementById('step-counter');
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-sidebar');

  var currentStep = 0;
  const revealOrder = config.revealOrder;
  const nodeMap = {};
  config.nodes.forEach(n => nodeMap[n.id] = n);

  // Compute SVG viewBox
  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  config.nodes.forEach(n => {
    minX = Math.min(minX, n.x - NODE_WIDTH/2 - 30);
    minY = Math.min(minY, n.y - NODE_HEIGHT/2 - 30);
    maxX = Math.max(maxX, n.x + NODE_WIDTH/2 + 30);
    maxY = Math.max(maxY, n.y + NODE_HEIGHT/2 + 30);
  });
  const vbPad = 40;
  const vbX = minX - vbPad, vbY = minY - vbPad;
  const vbW = maxX - minX + vbPad*2, vbH = maxY - minY + vbPad*2;

  function getEdgePoints(from, to) {
    const dx = to.x - from.x, dy = to.y - from.y;
    let sx, sy, ex, ey;
    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
      sx = from.x;
      sy = dy > 0 ? from.y + NODE_HEIGHT/2 : from.y - NODE_HEIGHT/2;
      ex = to.x;
      ey = dy > 0 ? to.y - NODE_HEIGHT/2 - ARROW_OFFSET : to.y + NODE_HEIGHT/2 + ARROW_OFFSET;
    } else {
      sx = dx > 0 ? from.x + NODE_WIDTH/2 : from.x - NODE_WIDTH/2;
      sy = from.y;
      ex = dx > 0 ? to.x - NODE_WIDTH/2 - ARROW_OFFSET : to.x + NODE_WIDTH/2 + ARROW_OFFSET;
      ey = to.y;
    }
    return { sx, sy, ex, ey };
  }

  // Build SVG
  let svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="${vbX} ${vbY} ${vbW} ${vbH}" width="100%" height="100%" style="background:#0d1117;">`;
  svg += `<defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#3fb950"/>
    </marker>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.3"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>`;

  // Edges
  config.edges.forEach((edge, i) => {
    const from = nodeMap[edge.from], to = nodeMap[edge.to];
    const pts = getEdgePoints(from, to);
    const pathD = `M ${pts.sx} ${pts.sy} L ${pts.ex} ${pts.ey}`;
    svg += `<path class="edge-path" data-edge="${i}" d="${pathD}" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>`;

    // Edge label
    const mx = (pts.sx + pts.ex) / 2;
    const my = (pts.sy + pts.ey) / 2;
    const tw = edge.label.length * 7 + 12;
    svg += `<g class="edge-label-group" data-edge="${i}">`;
    svg += `<rect class="edge-label-bg" x="${mx - tw/2}" y="${my - 9}" width="${tw}" height="18"/>`;
    svg += `<text class="edge-label-text" x="${mx}" y="${my + 1}">${edge.label}</text>`;
    svg += `</g>`;
  });

  // Nodes
  config.nodes.forEach(node => {
    const nx = node.x - NODE_WIDTH/2;
    const ny = node.y - NODE_HEIGHT/2;
    svg += `<g class="node-group" data-id="${node.id}" filter="url(#shadow)">`;
    svg += `<rect class="node-rect" x="${nx}" y="${ny}" width="${NODE_WIDTH}" height="${NODE_HEIGHT}" rx="12" ry="12"/>`;
    svg += `<text class="node-icon" x="${node.x - NODE_WIDTH/2 + 18}" y="${node.y + 8}" text-anchor="middle">${node.icon}</text>`;
    svg += `<text class="node-label" x="${node.x + 8}" y="${node.y - 4}" text-anchor="start">${node.label}</text>`;
    svg += `<text class="node-sublabel" x="${node.x + 8}" y="${node.y + 14}" text-anchor="start">${node.sublabel}</text>`;
    svg += `</g>`;
  });

  svg += `</svg>`;
  container.innerHTML = svg;

  // Reveal logic
  function revealNode(id, idx) {
    const group = document.querySelector(`.node-group[data-id="${id}"]`);
    if (group) {
      group.classList.add('revealed', 'reveal-anim');
    }
  }

  function revealEdgesUpTo(step) {
    config.edges.forEach((edge, i) => {
      const fromStep = revealOrder.indexOf(edge.from);
      const toStep = revealOrder.indexOf(edge.to);
      const path = document.querySelector(`.edge-path[data-edge="${i}"]`);
      const labelG = document.querySelector(`.edge-label-group[data-edge="${i}"]`);
      if (path && fromStep <= step && toStep <= step) {
        path.classList.add('active');
        if (labelG) labelG.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        path.classList.remove('active');
        if (labelG) labelG.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });
  }

  function showDetail(node) {
    const d = node.details;
    if (!d) return;
    placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    detailBox.style.display = 'block';
    let html = `<div class="detail-title">${node.icon} ${d.title}</div>`;
    html += `<div class="detail-body">${d.body}</div>`;
    if (d.insight) html += `<div class="insight">${d.insight}</div>`;
    if (d.misconception) html += `<div class="misconception">${d.misconception}</div>`;
    detailBox.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function updateUI() {
    revealEdgesUpTo(currentStep - 1);
    stepCounter.textContent = `第 ${currentStep} / ${revealOrder.length} 步`;
    btnPrev.disabled = currentStep <= 0;
    btnNext.disabled = currentStep >= revealOrder.length;
    btnNext.textContent = currentStep >= revealOrder.length ? '✓ 完成' : '下一步 ▶';
  }

  btnNext.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentStep >= revealOrder.length) return;
    const id = revealOrder[currentStep];
    currentStep++;
    revealNode(id, currentStep - 1);
    showDetail(nodeMap[id]);
    updateUI();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (currentStep <= 0) return;
    currentStep--;
    // Hide nodes after current step
    revealOrder.slice(currentStep).forEach(id => {
      const group = document.querySelector(`.node-group[data-id="${id}"]`);
      if (group) group.classList.remove('revealed', 'reveal-anim');
    });
    if (currentStep > 0) {
      const id = revealOrder[currentStep - 1];
      showDetail(nodeMap[id]);
    } else {
      detailBox.style.display = 'none';
      placeholder.style.display = 'block';
    }
    updateUI();
  });

  // Click on nodes
  document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => {
    g.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const id = g.dataset.id;
      const idx = revealOrder.indexOf(id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        // Select visual
        document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('selected'));
        g.classList.add('selected');
        showDetail(nodeMap[id]);
      }
    });
  });

  // Toggle sidebar
  toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  });

  // Init: reveal first node
  revealNode(revealOrder[0], 0);
  showDetail(nodeMap[revealOrder[0]]);
  currentStep = 1;
  updateUI();

})();
</script>

    closeHintOverlays();
    pause.style.zIndex='2147483000';
    pause.style.pointerEvents='auto';
    pause.querySelectorAll('p,h1,h2,h3').forEach(function(el){ el.style.pointerEvents='none'; });
    pause.querySelectorAll('button,.game-btn,.overlay-btn,.start-btn').forEach(function(el){
      el.style.position='relative';
      el.style.zIndex='2147483003';
      el.style.pointerEvents='auto';
    });
  }
  function wrapAndNormalize(name, after){
    var original = window[name];
    if (typeof original !== 'function' || original.__openMaicAuditWrapped) return;
    var wrapped = function(){
      var result = original.apply(this, arguments);
      try { after(); } catch (_) {}
      return result;
    };
    wrapped.__openMaicAuditWrapped = true;
    window[name] = wrapped;
  }
  ensure('startGame', function(){
    closeStartOverlays();
  });

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“线性/二次规划入口：关系图”。让我们用这张关系图来梳理一下它们之间的深层逻辑联系。

actions.content: 这是线性规划节点

actions.text: 看，图中有线性规划、二次规划和对偶问题三个核心节点。它们的连接逻辑是什么？

actions.content: 这是对偶问题节点

actions.text: 关键在于，拉格朗日量统一了它们的求解框架。无论是 LP 还是 QP，我们都可以写出拉格朗日函数，并推导出 KKT 条件。

actions.content: 展示统一的拉格朗日形式

actions.text: 一个常见的误解是认为线性规划必须依赖单纯形法等复杂算法。但从几何上看，它的本质就是在一个多面体上寻找目标函数的最优点，而二次规划不过是目标函数里多了个 H 矩阵。

actions.content: Q=0 的特殊情况

actions.text: 事实上，所有的线性规划都是二次规划中 H=0 的特殊情况。看这条连线——当你把二次项去掉，QP 就退化为 LP 了。请大家记住这个视角，它会帮你们跳过很多不必要的弯路。

            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Game Area */
        #game-canvas {

            width: 100%;

            overflow: hidden;
            cursor: crosshair;
        }

        /* Bin Styles */
        .bins-container {
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            height: 120px;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 10px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }

        .bin {
            flex: 1;
            border: 3px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
            border-radius: 15px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            position: relative;
        }

        .bin-lp { border-color: var(--lp-color); color: var(--lp-color); }
        .bin-qp { border-color: var(--qp-color); color: var(--qp-color); }

        .bin.active {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }

        .bin-label {
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .bin-sub {
            font-size: 10px;
            opacity: 0.8;
        }

        /* Expression Bubbles */
        .bubble {
            position: absolute;
            background: white;
            color: #333;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-weight: bold;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            cursor: grab;
            user-select: none;
            white-space: nowrap;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 5;
            transition: transform 0.1s;
        }

        .bubble:active { cursor: grabbing; transform: scale(1.1); }

        /* Overlays */
        .overlay {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(44, 62, 80, 0.95);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 100;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .hidden { display: none !important; }

        button {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 15px 40px;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
            cursor: pointer;
            margin-top: 20px;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

        .feedback-shape {
            position: absolute;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .achievement-popup {
            position: absolute;
            top: 80px;
            background: var(--accent);
            padding: 10px 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            animation: slideDown 2s forwards;
            z-index: 50;
        }

        @keyframes slideDown {
            0% { transform: translateY(-100px); opacity: 0; }
            20% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
            80% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
            100% { transform: translateY(-100px); opacity: 0; }
        }

        /* Geometric Icons */
        .shape-preview {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }
    </style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

<div id="game-container">
    <div id="hud">
        <div class="stat-box">
            <div class="stat-label">分数 Score</div>

    <div class="bins-container">

            <svg class="shape-preview" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
                <polygon points="20,20 80,30 90,80 30,90" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
            </svg>
            <div class="bin-label">线性规划 LP</div>
            <div class="bin-sub">Linear Programming</div>
        </div>
        <div id="bin-qp" class="bin bin-qp">
            <svg class="shape-preview" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
                <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="40" ry="25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" transform="rotate(-15 50 50)"/>
            </svg>

            <div class="bin-sub">Quadratic Programming</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Screens -->
    <div id="start-screen" class="overlay">
        <h1>📐 误解修复挑战</h1>
        <p style="max-width: 80%; line-height: 1.6;">
            数学公式正在实验室中乱飞！<br>
            识别公式中的<b>二次项 (Quadratic Terms)</b>，<br>
            将它们正确分类到 <b>LP</b> 或 <b>QP</b> 容器中。<br>
            <span style="color:var(--lp-color)">注意：带有平方项的约束绝不是 LP！</span>
        </p>
        <button onclick="startGame()">开始实验</button>
    </div>

    <div id="game-over-screen" class="overlay hidden">
        <h2 id="end-title">实验完成!</h2>
        <div id="end-stats" style="margin: 20px 0;"></div>
        <button onclick="startGame()">再来一次</button>

{
  "type": "game",

    "speedBonus": 5

<script>
/**
 * LP vs QP Challenge Game Logic
 */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Canvas setup
    const canvas = document.getElementById('geometry-bg');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    
    function resizeCanvas() {
        canvas.width = document.getElementById('game-canvas').clientWidth;
        canvas.height = document.getElementById('game-canvas').clientHeight;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
    resizeCanvas();

    // Game Constants
    const EXPRESSIONS = [
        { text: "min x + y", type: "LP", desc: "线性目标函数" },
        { text: "3x + 4y ≤ 12", type: "LP", desc: "线性约束 (多胞形边界)" },
        { text: "x, y ≥ 0", type: "LP", desc: "非负约束 (象限限制)" },
        { text: "Ax = b", type: "LP", desc: "等式约束 (超平面)" },
        { text: "max Σ c_i x_i", type: "LP", desc: "线性组合目标" },
        { text: "min x² + y²", type: "QP", desc: "二次目标函数 (凸抛物面)" },
        { text: "x² + y ≤ 10", type: "QP", desc: "二次约束 (非线性区域)" },
        { text: "½ xᵀQx + cᵀx", type: "QP", desc: "标准二次型" },
        { text: "xy ≤ 1", type: "QP", desc: "双曲约束 (二次项乘积)" },
        { text: "‖x‖₂ ≤ r", type: "QP", desc: "欧几里得范数约束 (圆/球)" },
        { text: "min (x-1)²", type: "QP", desc: "最小二乘目标" }
    ];

    // State Variables
    let score = 0;
    let totalAttempts = 0;
    let correctCount = 0;
    let gameActive = false;
    let activeBubbles = [];
    let lastSpawnTime = 0;
    let spawnRate = 2500; // ms
    let dragItem = null;

    // Helper: Global exposes
    window.startGame = function() {
        document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('game-over-screen').classList.add('hidden');
        
        score = 0;
        totalAttempts = 0;
        correctCount = 0;
        spawnRate = 2500;
        gameActive = true;
        activeBubbles.forEach(b => b.el.remove());
        activeBubbles = [];
        updateHUD();
        
        requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        
        // Grace period
        lastSpawnTime = Date.now() + 1000;
    };

    function updateHUD() {
        document.getElementById('score').innerText = score;
        const acc = totalAttempts === 0 ? 100 : Math.round((correctCount / totalAttempts) * 100);
        document.getElementById('accuracy').innerText = acc + "%";
    }

    function createBubble() {
        if (!gameActive) return;
        
        const data = EXPRESSIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * EXPRESSIONS.length)];
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'bubble';
        el.innerHTML = data.text;
        
        const gameArea = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
        gameArea.appendChild(el);
        
        const startX = Math.random() * (gameArea.clientWidth - 150) + 20;
        const startY = -50;
        
        const bubble = {
            el: el,
            data: data,
            x: startX,
            y: startY,
            vy: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.8,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
            width: el.offsetWidth,
            height: el.offsetHeight,
            isDragging: false
        };

        // Touch/Mouse Events
        const startDrag = (e) => {
            if (!gameActive) return;
            bubble.isDragging = true;
            dragItem = bubble;
            el.style.zIndex = 100;
            e.preventDefault();
        };

        el.addEventListener('mousedown', startDrag);
        el.addEventListener('touchstart', startDrag);

        activeBubbles.push(bubble);
    }

    // Input Tracking
    let pointerX = 0, pointerY = 0;
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        pointerX = e.clientX;
        pointerY = e.clientY;
    });
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
        pointerX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        pointerY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', endDrag);
    window.addEventListener('touchend', endDrag);

    function endDrag() {
        if (dragItem) {
            checkDrop(dragItem);
            dragItem.isDragging = false;
            dragItem.el.style.zIndex = 5;
            dragItem = null;
        }
    }

    function checkDrop(bubble) {
        const binLP = document.getElementById('bin-lp').getBoundingClientRect();
        const binQP = document.getElementById('bin-qp').getBoundingClientRect();
        
        let targetType = null;
        if (pointerY > binLP.top) {
            if (pointerX < window.innerWidth / 2) targetType = "LP";
            else targetType = "QP";
        }

        if (targetType) {
            totalAttempts++;
            if (bubble.data.type === targetType) {
                // Success
                score += 10;
                correctCount++;
                showVisualFeedback(bubble.data.type, pointerX, pointerY);
                createPopup(`正确: ${bubble.data.desc}`, 'var(--lp-color)');
            } else {
                // Fail
                score = Math.max(0, score - 5);
                createPopup(`错误! 这是 ${bubble.data.type}`, '#e74c3c');
            }
            
            // Remove bubble
            bubble.el.remove();
            activeBubbles = activeBubbles.filter(b => b !== bubble);
            updateHUD();
            
            // Progression
            spawnRate = Math.max(800, spawnRate - 50);
        }
    }

    function createPopup(text, color) {
        const p = document.createElement('div');
        p.className = 'achievement-popup';
        p.style.background = color;
        p.innerText = text;
        document.body.appendChild(p);
        setTimeout(() => p.remove(), 2000);
    }

    function showVisualFeedback(type, x, y) {
        // Simple canvas animation: draw a polygon for LP or circle for QP
        const particles = [];
        for(let i=0; i<8; i++) {
            particles.push({
                x: x, y: y - 100,
                vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*10,
                vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*10,
                life: 1.0
            });
        }

        const color = type === 'LP' ? '#2ecc71' : '#3498db';
        
        function animateParticles() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            particles.forEach(p => {
                p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.life -= 0.02;
                ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
                ctx.beginPath();
                if(type === 'LP') {
                    ctx.rect(p.x, p.y, 15, 15);
                } else {
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 8, 0, Math.PI*2);
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            });
            if (particles[0].life > 0) requestAnimationFrame(animateParticles);
        }
        animateParticles();
    }

    function gameLoop() {
        if (!gameActive) return;

        const now = Date.now();
        if (now - lastSpawnTime > spawnRate) {
            createBubble();
            lastSpawnTime = now;
        }

        const gameArea = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
        const bottomLimit = gameArea.clientHeight;

        for (let i = activeBubbles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const b = activeBubbles[i];
            
            if (b.isDragging) {
                const rect = gameArea.getBoundingClientRect();
                b.x = pointerX - rect.left - (b.width/2);
                b.y = pointerY - rect.top - (b.height/2);
            } else {
                b.y += b.vy;
                b.x += b.vx;
                
                // Wall bounce
                if (b.x < 0 || b.x > gameArea.clientWidth - b.width) b.vx *= -1;
                
                // Fall out of bounds
                if (b.y > bottomLimit) {
                    b.el.remove();
                    activeBubbles.splice(i, 1);
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            b.el.style.transform = `translate(${b.x}px, ${b.y}px)`;
        }

        // Highlight Bins
        const binLP = document.getElementById('bin-lp');
        const binQP = document.getElementById('bin-qp');
        binLP.classList.remove('active');
        binQP.classList.remove('active');

        if (dragItem) {
            const rect = gameArea.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (pointerY > rect.bottom) {
                if (pointerX < window.innerWidth / 2) binLP.classList.add('active');
                else binQP.classList.add('active');
            }
        }

        if (totalAttempts >= 15) {
            endGame();
            return;
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    function endGame() {
        gameActive = false;
        const screen = document.getElementById('game-over-screen');
        screen.classList.remove('hidden');
        
        const accuracy = Math.round((correctCount / totalAttempts) * 100);
        document.getElementById('end-stats').innerHTML = `
            <div style="font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px;">最终得分: ${score}</div>
            <div>公式分类准确率: ${accuracy}%</div>
            <p style="font-size: 14px; margin-top: 20px; color: #bdc3c7;">
                记得：<b>LP</b> 的可行域是多胞形 (Polytopes)，<br>
                由线性不等式定义的超平面交集。<br>
                <b>QP</b> 引入了曲率，使其具备更强的模拟能力，<br>
                但也对凸性 (Convexity) 有更严格的要求。
            </p>
        `;
    }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“线性/二次规划入口：误解修复挑战”。但说实话，很多人在第一次区分它们的时候，还是会掉进同一个陷阱——看到平方项就想当然。现在我们来一个快速挑战，把零碎的数学式子对号入座，看看哪些是 LP，哪些是 QP。

actions.content: 点击开始进入挑战

actions.text: 进去之后，你会看到一堆写着式子的卡片。把每张卡拖到它该去的框架里。尤其注意那些带平方的约束条件——它才是最容易让你翻车的地方。你上次就差一点被它骗了。

actions.content: 展示第一组卡片：包含一个平方约束的陷阱项

actions.text: 你看，式子 's.t. x₁² + x₂ ≤ 3' 里虽然有平方，但它出现在约束而非目标里。把它拖进 QP 试试，然后看看反馈会怎么纠正你。

actions.content: 这个约束带平方，但规划的类型仍由目标函数决定

actions.text: 等你把整组卡片都归对位置，页面上会自动弹出这个规划的 2D 几何形状。看到形状的那一刻，你才算真正懂了分类背后的直觉。大家，拿不准就多试几轮，速度不重要，想清楚原理才是关键。

actions.content: 正确分类后将揭示对应的二维几何区域

actions.text: 好，现在开始你的挑战。把每个式子都放在它该在的地方，然后亲眼确认那个几何形状的出现。

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>线性/二次规划 · 空间视角</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 16px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
    #loading .spinner {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      padding: 14px 12px 28px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: flex-end;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 120px;
    }

    label {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: #999;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    }

    .label-bilingual {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #bbb;
    }
    .label-bilingual small {
      color: #777;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: #2a2a3a;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 2px solid #818cf8;
    }

    button {
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #2a2a3a;
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 44px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    button:hover { background: #3a3a4a; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; }
    button.primary:hover { background: #5558e8; }
    button.active { background: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99,102,241,0.5); }

    .zoom-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .zoom-btns button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: bold;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .mode-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 320px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2);
      z-index: 10;
    }
    #info h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    #info .subtitle {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #888;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    #info p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #ccc;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    #info .formula {
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      display: inline-block;
      margin: 4px 0;
      color: #e0e0ff;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    #info .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: bold;
      margin: 2px 4px 2px 0;
    }
    .tag-lp { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); color: #4ade80; }
    .tag-qp { background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2); color: #fbbf24; }
    .tag-convex { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); color: #60a5fa; }
    .tag-nonconvex { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #f87171; }

    #status {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      background: rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2);
      z-index: 10;
      min-width: 180px;
    }
    #status h3 {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #888;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    #status .value {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    #status .detail {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #aaa;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      #status { display: none; }
      #controls { padding: 10px 8px 24px; gap: 8px; }
      .control-group { min-width: 90px; }
    }
  </style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
